title: CSS - PM - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Consulting Support Services – Manager**
**The opportunity**
* CSS enables Consulting Project team’s efficiency and delivery through the key project management and coordination activities.
* We take responsibility for end–to–end project lifecycle essential for project delivery. We manage project financial analysis, tracking and reporting, project communication, compliance \& governance activities across all Field of Play.
* This role offers first\-hand experience of project management on a wide spectrum of services leading to skill enhancement and long\-term career growth in consulting. It affords an opportunity to lead and manage as well as develop talent, contributing to success and growth of the organization.


**Your Key Role And Responsibilities**
* Conceptualizing visuals based on consulting business requirements – presentation and documentation
* Exceptional writing, speaking, proof\-reading and organizational skills
* Responsible for developing timely, cohesive, high\-quality and competitive proposals
* Responsible for layout, formatting, production of proposals for presentations, white papers and other documents
* Familiar with creating story boards and illustrations for consulting (business \& technical) pursuit deals
* Provide guidance regarding changes necessary in content, style and organization
* Have techno functional mindset with lateral thinking for providing differentiated customer experience, best suited to meet requirements leading to deal win.
* Showcase innovative and unique design skills to represent data and proposal decks in EY/Client specific format while being compliant to branding guidelines


**Business management**
* Manage deployment and utilization of team assigned, span of 10\-20, Staff, Senior and AMs
* Manage operational activities like co\-ordination, supervision, work allocation and compliance
* Source and share feedback with team members, contribute to mid\-year/annual appraisal cycles
* Expand CSS integration across member firms through building networks and developing new services
* Involve in people initiatives including recruiting and training professionals and act as a role model
* Lead and collaborate on team and consulting level initiatives
* Quality control, review of the team's work, and ensuring overall adherence to SLAs and KPIs
* Support quality and risk management needs across consulting practices (InfoSec, Data Privacy etc.)
* To facilitate transition of new work from project initiation to 'business as usual' and focus on continuous improvement/efficiency gains
* Be insightful about the Consulting Fields of Plays and utilize that knowledge to make suggestions and/or recommendations
* Full time role
* Onsite/work from office needed (hybrid)
* Flexible to work with different time zones
* Willing to work on Indian Holidays as per client requirement
* Willing to travel, within the country and internationally as required.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Any Graduate/Postgraduate, preferably B.Com/BBA/Economics/B.Tech or master’s degree
* Good to have CSM/PSM, CAPM/Prince2/PMP, Project Management Fundamentals or Six sigma certification
* Prior experience of 2\+ years in creative and content designing, preferably working on drafting responses on RFPs/RFIs
* Professional services design teams or advertising agencies exposure with consulting firms are a big plus
* Adobe cloud software's like Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator, After effects, Premiere Pro
* Proficiency in Microsoft applications (PowerPoint, Excel \- charts and graphs and Word)
* Blender, Templafy, Deck Robot and other leading applications
* Worked on sales pitch enhancement tools like Prezi
* Familiarity with animation and creating storyboard marketing videos are valued skills.
* Involvement during presales stages
* Exposure with building Murals and Visio flow
* Web design and understanding of user interface principles are good to have.
* Strong English communication \- both written and verbal
* Attention to detail even when dealing with routine tasks
* Confident, Assertive, with strong communication and influencing skills
* Ability to comprehend EYs business, think strategically, adapt to change
* Experience with go to market activities, should have proposal drafting and strong presentation skills
* Ability to identify problems, perform research, solve complex business problems and recommend solutions
* Prior experience working with Global cliental required
* Self\-starter, excellent team player, organized and self\-disciplined. Ability to work with senior leadership


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role
   

  

 with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: BCM-FINACLE-Techno Functional-Manager-GDSF02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Consulting – Banking \& Capital Markets: Finacle Core Banking**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. **Level Manager**

**Domain Retail and Corporate Banking, Lending, Payments and Cards, Compliance, Treasury, Investment Banking and Wealth Management**

* Work as a Lead or Senior Business Analyst and techno\-functional consultant in banking transformation programs.
* Lead requirements workshops, process discovery sessions, and solution discussions with business and technology stakeholders.
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications, solution requirements, and system design inputs.
* Drive requirements analysis, gap assessment, configuration advisory, and solution mapping across Finacle and surrounding banking applications.
* Prepare and review BRDs, FRDs, user stories, use cases, process flows, data mappings, and interface specifications.
* Coordinate across Business, Technology, Development, Testing, Infrastructure, Data Migration and Vendor teams.
* Provide functional and technical clarifications to integration, migration and testing teams.

* Support SIT, UAT, Simulation, Go\-Live and Hypercare activities.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Understanding of Digital Banking, Mobile Banking, Open Banking, API\-led architectures, microservices, cloud, DevOps and RPA concepts.

* Experience developing and customizing front\-end interfaces, menus and client\-side components for Finacle 11x.
* Strong banking knowledge across deposits, loans, cash management, collections, payments, forex, trade finance, liquidity, KYC, cards, treasury and wealth management.
* Knowledge of payment and settlement systems including SWIFT, TARGET2, EBA and ISO 20022\.
* Strong client\-facing communication, leadership, stakeholder management, analytical and problem\-solving skills.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* MBA, MCA, BE, BTech or equivalent qualification with banking industry experience.
* Experience leading Business Analysis teams and large\-scale core banking transformation, migration or upgrade programs.
* Project or program management, PMO governance, risk management and stakeholder reporting exposure.
* Experience using Generative AI and prompt engineering.
* Relevant certifications such as CBAP, CCBA, PMI\-PBA, PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum, Finacle, TOGAF or ITIL

title: Creative Team Lead
description:

* Relevant degree or equivalent professional experience in design, advertising, visual communication, or related fields.

title: Manager of Engineering
description:
Industry: Healthcare Technology / SaaS
 



 Location: Onsite \- Kochi
 



 Employment Type: Full\-Time
 



  





**About the Company** 




  





 We are a rapidly growing technology company operating in the healthcare SaaS industry. Our platform supports healthcare organizations through innovative software solutions designed to improve operational efficiency, clinical workflows, revenue cycle management, and the overall delivery of healthcare services.
 



  





 We are seeking an experienced Engineering Manager to join our growing technology organization and provide technical leadership, people management, and execution oversight across multiple software development initiatives.
 



  





**Position Summary** 




  





 The Engineering Manager will lead and develop a team of software engineers while working closely with Product Management, Engineering leadership, QA, and other business stakeholders to deliver high\-quality, scalable, secure, and reliable healthcare technology solutions.
 



  





 This role requires a combination of technical expertise, leadership ability, project execution, and people management skills. The ideal candidate will be comfortable operating in a fast\-paced SaaS environment and will have experience guiding engineering teams through the full software development lifecycle.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Engineering Leadership** 




  





 \- Lead, mentor, and manage a team of software engineers.
 



 \- Establish engineering standards, development practices, and technical processes.
 



 \- Provide technical guidance and support to engineers when addressing complex development challenges.
 



 \- Review architectural and technical decisions and ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, and secure.
 



 \- Promote engineering best practices, including code quality, testing, documentation, version control, and CI/CD.
 



 \- Identify technical risks and work proactively to resolve them.
 



  





**Product \& Project Delivery** 




  





 \- Partner closely with Product Management to translate business and product requirements into technical solutions.
 



 \- Participate in product planning, technical discovery, estimation, prioritization, and roadmap discussions.
 



 \- Ensure engineering projects are delivered on time and meet defined quality standards.
 



 \- Monitor project progress, identify blockers, and coordinate resources to maintain delivery schedules.
 



 \- Balance short\-term delivery requirements with long\-term technical scalability and maintainability.
 



 \- Collaborate with QA and other teams to ensure production\-ready releases.
 



  





**People Management** 




  





 \- Conduct regular one\-on\-one meetings, provide coaching, and support employee development.
 



 \- Establish clear expectations and performance goals for engineering team members.
 



 \- Provide ongoing feedback and participate in performance evaluations.
 



 \- Identify training and professional development opportunities.
 



 \- Assist with recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, and retaining engineering talent.
 



 \- Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
 



  





**Healthcare Technology \& Security** 




  





 \- Ensure engineering practices align with applicable healthcare technology, privacy, security, and compliance requirements.
 



 \- Work with security and compliance teams to address application security and data protection requirements.
 



 \- Promote secure software development practices, particularly when handling sensitive healthcare information.
 



 \- Support appropriate documentation and controls related to healthcare SaaS applications.
 



  





**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 




  





 \- Work closely with Product Management, QA, DevOps, Security, Customer Success, and other departments.
 



 \- Communicate technical concepts and project status effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
 



 \- Help resolve cross\-functional issues and establish clear ownership and accountability.
 



 \- Represent Engineering in relevant business and product discussions.
 



  





**Required Qualifications** 




  





 \- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
 



 \- 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience.
 



 \- 2\+ years of engineering management or technical leadership experience.
 



 \- Strong understanding of software development methodologies and the full SDLC.
 



 \- Experience designing, developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining SaaS applications.
 



 \- Experience with modern software development frameworks, APIs, databases, cloud technologies, and development tools.
 



 \- Strong understanding of software architecture, scalability, performance, and application security.
 



 \- Experience working with Agile/Scrum or similar development methodologies.
 



 \- Strong communication, organization, problem\-solving, and leadership skills.
 



 \- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
 



 \- Experience working in healthcare technology, healthcare SaaS, EHR, practice management, RCM, or related industries.
 



 \- Experience working with HIPAA\-regulated environments or other healthcare privacy and security requirements.
 



 \- Experience managing distributed or multi\-location engineering teams.
 



 \- Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
 



 \- Experience with CI/CD, DevOps, automated testing, monitoring, and production support.
 



 \- Experience working with AI/ML technologies or integrating AI capabilities into SaaS products.
 



 \- Experience leading teams through significant product growth, modernization, or platform transformation.
 



  





  





**What We Offer** 




  





 \- Opportunity to lead engineering initiatives within a growing healthcare technology organization.
 



 \- Opportunity to work on products that directly support healthcare providers and organizations.
 



 \- Collaborative and technology\-focused work environment.
 



 \- Professional growth and leadership development opportunities.
 



 \- Competitive compensation and benefits package.
 



 \- Opportunity to work with modern SaaS, cloud, automation, and emerging technology platforms.
 



  





**Confidentiality** 




  





 The company name and certain organizational details have been intentionally omitted from this job description due to the confidential nature of the recruitment process. Additional information regarding the organization, product portfolio, team structure, and specific responsibilities will be provided during the interview process.

title: Head of Research and Development
description:
**Head of R\&D**
 Metantz connects the top 1% talents to global opportunities. This is an exciting opportunity with our award winning customer, a deeptech ROV company, setting category benchmarks.
   

  

**About The Company**
 We're a Kochi\-based deep\-tech company building underwater robots for places people can't safely reach: dams, ports, ships and offshore infrastructure. Defence, government, infrastructure and energy customers in India and abroad already use our systems in the field. We are moving from a strong engineering team to a company that ships scalable products, and we need a leader to build the R\&D engine that gets us there.
   

  

**The role**
 You will own technology and product development end to end and report to the CEO, CTO. This isn't a pure research role or a chief\-engineer role. You will turn customer and mission needs into reliable, manufacturable products, make R\&D delivery predictable, and build a team that doesn't depend on any one person, including you.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Set the 2–3 year technology and product roadmap, and keep experimental work separate from committed deliverables.
* Lead programs from requirements and architecture through prototype, field trials, design freeze and production handover.
* Strengthen systems engineering across mechanical, electronics, embedded, software, controls, sensors and communications.
* Build rigorous testing lab, environmental, endurance and field trials. Turn every field failure into a lasting fix.
* Make every handover to production clean, with complete drawings, BOMs, firmware versions and test procedures.
* Work with Sales on feasibility and estimates before commitments are made, and control scope creep from custom requests.
* Build the R\&D leadership team, succession depth and a technical career path alongside the management track.
* Own the R\&D budget, labs, vendors and partners. Protect IP and manage technology risk such as obsolescence and single\-source parts.
* Act as a senior member of the leadership team, not the head of a silo.


**You might be a fit if you have**
* 15\+ years in engineering and R\&D, including 5\+ years leading multi\-disciplinary product teams.
* Taken integrated hardware and software products from concept through validation and industrialization to field deployment.
* Background in robotics, autonomous systems, marine, defence or aerospace, embedded or industrial electronics (strongly preferred).
* Experience with mission\-critical, high\-reliability, government or defence requirements (a plus).
* A Bachelor's or Master's in electronics, electrical, mechanical, mechatronics, robotics, computer science or a related field.
* Strong systems thinking, sound technical judgment and the discipline to deliver on commitments.


**What Success Looks Like In 180 Days**
* An assessment of the R\&D organization, active programs, technical debt and key\-person risks is complete.
* One consolidated portfolio view exists, with clear priorities, owners and milestones.
* A roadmap and capacity plan are agreed, and Sales and Operations plan against realistic R\&D commitments.
* The top recurring field and production issues are being closed through root\-cause fixes.
* A weekly and monthly governance cadence surfaces risks early.


**What This Role Is Not**
 It isn't research detached from delivery, a hero\-engineer role where every decision runs through you, project coordination without authority, or constant firefighting at the expense of product maturity.
   

  

**Why join**
 You will build frontier robotics that work in some of the harshest environments on earth, work directly with the founders, and shape an R\&D organization at a pivotal stage of growth.
   

  

**Location**
 Kochi, Kerala. Full\-time, with travel for trials, customers and partners.

title: Senior Security Consultant
description:
**Company Description** 
 Crowe Advisory Services (India) LLP, a member of Crowe Global since 1999, delivers services in Risk Advisory, Corporate Finance, Taxation, Business Advisory, Digital Security Consulting, Data Sciences, and Business Process Outsourcing. The firm operates from eight offices across India, including Mumbai, New Delhi, Bengaluru, Pune, Ahmedabad, Kochi, Gurgaon, and Noida. Crowe India and its associate entities comprise 36 partners and directors, supported by around 1,800 team members. Through Crowe Global’s network of 765 offices in 146 countries, the firm provides seamless professional services to both local and multinational clients. Professionals joining Crowe India gain exposure to diverse industries, complex business challenges, and collaborative work with global teams.
   

  

**Role Description** 
 The Senior Security Consultant role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Kochi. The role involves assessing client security postures, performing risk assessments, and designing security frameworks across applications, networks, and information assets. Responsibilities include conducting security audits and vulnerability assessments, recommending remediation strategies, and supporting implementation of security controls and policies. The consultant will collaborate with client stakeholders to develop security roadmaps, prepare technical and management\-level reports, and contribute to proposals and thought leadership in cybersecurity and digital security consulting. The role also includes mentoring junior team members and coordinating with cross\-functional teams to ensure that security requirements are integrated into business and technology initiatives.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 .  Lead and managed engagements for SOC 1 (Type I \& II) and SOC 2 (Type I \& II) audits including planning, fieldwork, and reporting.
   

* Assess design and operating effectiveness of internal controls over financial reporting (SOC 1\) and trust services criteria (SOC 2\).
* Minimum 7\+ years of experuence
* Evaluate existing client controls and processes against AICPA Trust Services Criteria (TSC) for Security, Availability, Confidentiality, Processing Integrity, and Privacy.
* Serve as the primary client contact, handling stakeholder communication, status updates, and issue resolution.
* Review and validate control evidence, assess the design and operating effectiveness of controls, and identify any deficiencies.
* Lead walkthroughs and meetings with process owners and external auditors.
* Advise clients on control design, remediation strategies, and audit readiness.
* Prepare high\-quality reports and presentations summarizing findings, risks, and remediation recommendations.
* Provide gap assessments and readiness reviews for SOC compliance.
* Stay up to date with evolving regulatory, compliance, and cybersecurity trends, especially related to SOC, ISO 27001, NIST, and similar frameworks.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to clients throughout the audit lifecycle.
* Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Manage timelines, deliverables, and expectations across multiple engagements.
* Experience with audit tools and GRC platforms (e.g., AuditBoard, LogicGate, ServiceNow).
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CEH, OSCP, or equivalent are highly beneficial.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field.
* Ability to analyze complex technical issues, communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders, and prepare concise security reports.
* Experience in client\-facing roles, strong teamwork and mentoring skills, and the ability to work independently in a fast\-paced consulting environment.

title: Client Performance Strategist
description:
**Job description:** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on Senior SEO \& Client Performance Strategist to join our team. In this critical, client\-facing role, you will act as a "first responder" for underperforming SEO accounts. You will be responsible for diagnosing performance gaps, validating data integrity, and creating high\-impact recovery roadmaps.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* **Performance Monitoring:** 
 Conduct monthly performance reviews for assigned SEO clients, focusing deeply on those classified as "Caution" or "Underperforming".1
* **Data Validation:** 
 Ensure data accuracy across platforms (e.g., GA4, Google Search Console, CRM, and call\-tracking) to distinguish between genuine performance issues and measurement discrepancies.
* **Root\-Cause Diagnosis:** 
 Investigate underperformance across technical SEO, conversion paths, and broader business factors (e.g., budget changes, seasonality, or client operations).
* **Strategic Planning:** 
 Develop practical improvement plans that prioritize high\-impact actions. You will maintain an action tracker to ensure accountability, tracking progress and blocking issues until resolution.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** 
 Partner with Account Managers to provide clear, actionable performance narratives to clients. You will work across delivery teams (Content, Dev, PPC, etc.) to implement necessary changes.
* **Process Improvement:** 
 Identify recurring issues to develop diagnostic checklists, recovery playbooks, and training materials, contributing to the overall quality standards of the agency.



 What You Bring
 


* **Experience:** 
 5\+ years of SEO experience, ideally within a digital marketing agency.1
* **Technical Expertise:** 
 Advanced knowledge of technical, on\-page, local, and off\-page SEO, plus content strategy.
* **Analytical Skills:** 
 Strong proficiency in tools like Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, Semrush, and Screaming Frog, with a demonstrated ability to evaluate complex CRM and call\-tracking data.
* **Strategic Thinking:**

title: Electrical Site Engineer
description:
**Location: Kochi, Kerala** 




**Experience: Minimum 3\+ Years** 




**Qualification: ITI / Diploma / B.Tech in Electrical Engineering** 




  





**Job Summary** 




  





 We are looking for an experienced Electrical Site Engineer to oversee and monitor electrical works at construction project sites. The ideal candidate should have a strong background in the construction industry and be capable of supervising electrical contractors, ensuring work quality, monitoring project progress, and coordinating with consultants, clients, and project teams. The candidate should possess sound technical knowledge of electrical systems and be able to read and interpret AutoCAD drawings.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  




* Supervise and monitor all electrical works carried out at construction sites.
* Ensure electrical works are executed as per approved drawings, specifications, project schedules, and quality standards.
* Coordinate with electrical contractors, consultants, project managers, site engineers, and clients for smooth project execution.
* Review electrical drawings, layouts, and shop drawings using AutoCAD.
* Monitor site progress and ensure timely completion of electrical activities.
* Verify that materials used at site comply with approved specifications and project requirements.
* Conduct regular site inspections and identify quality or safety issues.
* Coordinate with the procurement team for material requirements and delivery schedules.
* Resolve site\-related technical issues in consultation with project and design teams.
* Maintain daily site reports, progress updates, inspection records, and documentation.
* Attend project coordination meetings with consultants, contractors, and clients.
* Support testing, inspection, commissioning, and final project handover activities by ensuring all works are completed as per approved standards.



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* Minimum 3\+ years of experience as an Electrical Site Engineer in the construction industry.
* Strong technical knowledge of electrical systems used in commercial, healthcare, hospitality, and industrial construction projects.
* Ability to read, understand, and review electrical drawings, layouts, and single\-line diagrams.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD is mandatory.



  





**Good understanding of:** 




  




* Electrical distribution systems
* HT/LT systems
* Panels and Distribution Boards (DBs)
* Cable routing and containment systems
* Earthing and lightning protection systems
* Lighting and power layouts
* Fire alarm and ELV coordination
* Testing and commissioning procedures
* Strong knowledge of electrical standards, safety regulations, and quality control practices.
* Excellent supervision, coordination, and communication skills.
* Ability to identify and resolve site issues efficiently.



  





**Qualification** 




  




* ITI / Diploma or B.Tech in Electrical Engineering.
* Minimum 3 years of relevant construction site experience.



  





**Preferred Candidate Profile** 




  




* Hands\-on experience supervising electrical works on construction projects.
* Strong coordination skills with contractors, consultants, and multidisciplinary project teams.
* Ability to manage multiple site activities and meet project deadlines.
* Willingness to travel to project sites across Kerala as required.

description:
**Job Description**
 The Senior MES Delivery Lead will work closely with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Automation, IT, Data Backbone teams, and external technology partners to drive MES adoption and support manufacturing transformation initiatives. Responsibilities include process analysis, requirements engineering, workshop facilitation, solution evaluation, architecture collaboration, implementation support, deployment planning, testing, documentation, and continuous improvement activities.
   

  

 The successful candidate will act as a subject matter expert for MES and digital manufacturing systems, helping to define future\-state manufacturing processes, support Smart Factory initiatives, and contribute to the long\-term development of SPS's manufacturing technology landscape. As the program evolves, the role is expected to progress toward ownership of MES strategy, deployment activities, and future capability development within the organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead and support MES implementation, deployment, and scaling activities across SPS manufacturing sites globally.
* Analyse manufacturing processes and identify opportunities for digitalisation, automation, process optimisation, and operational improvements.
* Gather, define, structure, and maintain business, functional, technical, and architectural requirements for MES and related manufacturing systems.
* Develop and maintain manufacturing use cases, business scenarios, process flows, and solution evaluation criteria.
* Facilitate workshops with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Planning, Automation, IT, and business stakeholders to capture requirements and align solution designs.
* Evaluate MES modules and capabilities against business needs, technology architecture, integration requirements, scalability, and long\-term sustainability objectives.
* Contribute to solution architecture design involving MES, ERP, PLM, SCADA, PLC, Historian, APS, and related manufacturing systems.
* Support integration planning and coordination between enterprise platforms and manufacturing systems to ensure effective information flow across the manufacturing environment.
* Participate in system testing, validation activities, deployment planning, issue resolution, and implementation support throughout project lifecycles.
* Collaborate closely with Smart Factory, Data Backbone, Automation, Quality, Engineering, Operations, IT teams, and external technology vendors.
* Prepare documentation including requirements specifications, process maps, evaluation reports, implementation plans, testing documentation, and deployment materials.
* Support decision\-making processes through technical analysis, solution recommendations, and business case development.
* Promote best practices in digital manufacturing, Industry 4\.0, Smart Factory solutions, and manufacturing system governance.
* Take ownership of assigned initiatives and drive activities through completion while effectively communicating progress, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Contribute to the development of future MES capabilities and support the growth of SPS's digital manufacturing competency.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Automation Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Systems, Industrial Automation, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), manufacturing systems, industrial digitalisation, Smart Factory initiatives, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading or supporting end\-to\-end MES implementation, deployment, and rollout projects within manufacturing environments.
* Strong understanding of MES integration with ERP, PLC, SCADA, Historian, APS, PLM, Quality Management Systems, and related manufacturing technologies.
* Experience conducting manufacturing process mapping, business analysis, requirements gathering, workshop facilitation, and solution evaluation activities.
* Good understanding of enterprise architecture and manufacturing system architecture principles.
* Ability to work effectively across Operations, Engineering, Quality, IT, and business stakeholder groups.
* Experience working within manufacturing environments and a strong understanding of shopfloor operations and production processes.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, documentation, and communication skills.
* Experience with MES platforms such as AVEVA, Critical Manufacturing, Siemens Opcenter, Rockwell FactoryTalk, Proficy, or similar solutions is preferred.
* Experience supporting global or multi\-site manufacturing deployments is highly desirable.
* Exposure to Industry 4\.0, Industrial Data Backbone, Unified Namespace (UNS), MQTT, Industrial Historian platforms, or related technologies is advantageous.
* Experience within engineer\-to\-order, project\-based, high\-mix, batch, continuous, or other complex manufacturing environments is preferred.
* Demonstrates ownership, leadership, and a proactive approach to driving initiatives, managing stakeholders, and delivering business outcomes.
* Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in international and cross\-functional teams.
* Willingness to travel internationally, including visits to Denmark, Brazil, the UK, and other SPS manufacturing locations as required.

description:

 We are seeking an experienced Microservices Architect to perform the role of Engineering Manager, leading the architecture, design, planning, and delivery of large\-scale eCommerce initiatives built on a Java\-based microservices ecosystem. This role combines engineering leadership, solution architecture, and delivery ownership to ensure successful execution of strategic platform modernization and customer experience initiatives.
   

  

 This is a technology\-first, hands\-on engineering leadership role. The successful candidate must remain actively involved in architecture, technical decision\-making, engineering quality, and solution delivery while leading distributed engineering teams.
   

  

**Core Requirements**
* 15\+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 5 years in engineering leadership, architecture, or delivery leadership roles.
* Design distributed data architectures and determine appropriate database strategies across relational, NoSQL, cache, search, and event\-streaming platforms.
* Familiar with observability platforms like Jaeger, Prometheus, Grafana.
* Define microservices architecture, service boundaries, bounded contexts, and domain decomposition using DDD principles.
* Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio or equivalent.
* Strong hands\-on engineering background in Java and Spring Boot microservices, with the ability to review architecture, designs, APIs, and implementation approaches.
* Experience designing and delivering large\-scale eCommerce or digital\-commerce platforms.

**The Opportunity**
 The SAP TM Transportation Management Senior Consultant serves as a senior\-level advisor responsible for leading complex SAP Transportation Management (TM) transformation initiatives for enterprise clients. This role combines deep SAP TM expertise with strategic consulting capabilities to design, implement, and optimize end\-to\-end transportation solutions that drive operational excellence, cost reduction, and supply chain visibility. The consultant participates in pursuing client sales opportunities and working on bid \& proposal efforts along with activities including configuration and setting up the SAP TM system, assessment of client business problems, conducting the analysis to solve the problems, administration of engagement activities while contributing to practice growth and innovation.

**Technical and Professional Requirements:**
* 8\-10 years of experience in implementation, support and upgrade projects in SAP TM

**Core SAP TM Competencies:**
* Comprehensive knowledge in all L3 aspects of SAP TM such as Order Management (Logistics Integration, Freight Unit, Forwarding Order, Freight Order, Freight Booking), Transportation Planning and Execution, Carrier Selection, Charge Calculation and Freight Settlement, Invoice Integration and Carrier Communication methodologies
* Proficiency in Master Data setup such as Resource Management, Locations, Business Partners etc.
* Deep understanding of SAP TM integration with SAP ERP S/4HANA logistics (SD, MM, LE) and embedded TM scenarios
* Expertise in Transportation Planning strategies: manual planning, Transportation Cockpit, optimizer\-based planning (VSR), and automated freight unit building
* Proficiency in Freight Order Lifecycle Management, Freight Tendering processes, Subcontracting and Execution monitoring
* Advanced knowledge of Charge calculation, Freight Agreement Management, Rate tables and Transportation cost allocation


**Technical Skills:**
* SAP TM configuration and customizing across all functional areas (master data, organizational structures, profiles setup for Planning, business rules such as BRF\+ conditions)
* Data migration methodologies using DRF, LSMW, SAP Data Services, or Migration Cockpit; system landscape design (Development, Quality, Production)
* Understanding of SAP TM on HANA optimization, performance tuning, and analytics capabilities
* Expertise in implementation planning, fit\-gap analysis, SAP TM system configuration E2E, testing, rollout and post\-implementation support.


**Industry Knowledge:**
* Expertise in logistics and supply chain operations across multiple transportation modes (road, rail, ocean, air, intermodal)
* Knowledge of carrier management practices, freight procurement, contract negotiations, and service level agreements
* Familiarity with industry best practices, benchmarks, and emerging trends (sustainability, real\-time visibility, autonomous transportation)

* Proven ability to engage with client and influence strategic decision\-making
* Expertise in requirements gathering through workshops, interviews, and process analysis; translating business needs into technical specifications
* Change management and organizational adoption strategies, including training program design, communication planning, and stakeholder engagement

**Solution Design**
* End\-to\-end solution architecture spanning SAP TM, ERP or S/4 HANA, EWM, GTS, and third\-party logistics systems (TMS, WMS, visibility platforms)
* Business process optimization using Lean Six Sigma or similar methodologies; identification of automation opportunities and efficiency gains
* Integration strategy development including point\-to\-point, hub\-based, and API\-led connectivity approaches
* Oversight of custom development (ABAP, SAPUI5, BRF\+) ensuring adherence to SAP standards and maintainability


**Leadership \& Delivery**

**Role Title: GDS Microsoft Partner Program Specialist**
**The opportunity**
 The Microsoft Partner Program Specialist will support the governance, operational management, value realization and continuous improvement of EY’s Microsoft alliance partner program ecosystem from Argentina. Hands\-on Microsoft Partner Center knowledge is the defining capability for this role and will be the primary criterion used to screen, interview and evaluate candidates. The role will work closely with Microsoft Alliance Leadership, Operations, Finance, Go\-to\-Market (GTM), Service Lines, Business Development and Microsoft\-facing stakeholders to translate partner program priorities into structured processes, accurate reporting, actionable insights and measurable business outcomes.
   

  

 This role is focused on strengthening how EY manages and optimizes Microsoft partner program activities, including benefits, incentives, eligibility, utilization, compliance, documentation and governance. The individual will help establish operating rhythms, maintain program trackers, support decision forums, monitor key performance indicators and provide portfolio\-level visibility that improves transparency, accountability and leadership decision\-making.
   

  

 The successful candidate will act as a dependable connector across alliance, finance, operations and business stakeholders, ensuring partner program activities are executed consistently and aligned to broader Microsoft alliance objectives. The role will support process standardization, issue tracking, stakeholder follow\-through and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance program effectiveness and the overall stakeholder experience.
   

  

 Leveraging automation, analytics and AI\-enabled productivity tools, the role will help modernize partner program management by improving reporting quality, increasing operational efficiency, strengthening benefit realization and generating practical insights that support planning, governance and business growth. Through disciplined execution and strong attention to detail, the role will contribute to maximizing the value of EY’s Microsoft partnership.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Support the Partner Program Management function for the Microsoft Alliance by coordinating program benefits, incentives, eligibility, investments, marketplace/co\-sell priorities and related alliance growth activities.
* Maintain operating models, governance routines, KPI trackers, executive review inputs, escalation logs and control mechanisms for Microsoft partner programs.
* Own and administer Microsoft Partner Center as the role’s primary operational responsibility, including account and organization profiles, program enrollments, agreements, user access and role\-based permissions, location and tenant associations, incentives and benefits workspaces, referrals/co\-sell, marketplace\-related configurations, access troubleshooting and supporting audit trails, in coordination with authorized administrators and control owners.
* Translate Microsoft alliance priorities into structured execution plans, program trackers, eligibility logs, utilization summaries, partner updates, portfolio views and compliance\-ready documentation.
* Monitor program performance across funding utilization, benefits realization, investment governance, incentive tracking, specialization readiness, risk indicators and leadership reporting.
* Prepare executive\-ready dashboards, business updates, decision materials, portfolio summaries and governance inputs that support leadership reviews and prioritization discussions.
* Coordinate with stakeholders across EY Microsoft Alliance, Finance, Operations, GTM, Service Lines, Business Development, Markets and Microsoft\-facing teams to align priorities and drive timely follow\-through.
* Support governance forums, working sessions and leadership reviews by maintaining decision logs, action trackers, RAID logs, issue registers and follow\-up mechanisms.
* Identify dependencies, policy constraints, partner requirements, execution risks and commercial implications; recommend practical mitigation steps and escalate issues where required.
* Support revenue\-enabling motions by improving program\-backed enablement, partner value realization, investment return, pipeline visibility and alliance operating effectiveness.
* Standardize repeatable processes across regions and teams while adapting execution support to local stakeholder needs and global Microsoft Alliance requirements.
* Partner with reporting and analytics teams to develop Power BI dashboards, structured scorecards, trend analysis and actionable insights for leadership reviews.
* Use Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, Fabric, workflow automation and AI\-enabled productivity tools responsibly to streamline reporting, summarize updates, identify risks and improve decision quality.
* Ensure program documentation, controls and reporting outputs align with EY policies, Microsoft program requirements, audit expectations, data privacy standards and quality guidelines.
* Contribute to team capability by creating reusable templates, improving documentation, sharing best practices and promoting insight\-led continuous improvement.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong experience in alliance operations, partner programs, ecosystem support, strategic PMO, commercial operations, business reporting, transformation support or governance operations.
* Good understanding of Microsoft partner ecosystem themes, including incentives, Solution Partner designations, specializations, marketplace, co\-sell, cloud, Data and AI, security, business applications and program investment frameworks.
* Microsoft Partner Center administration is the mandatory core requirement and primary evaluation criterion for this role. Candidates must demonstrate current, hands\-on capability across account settings, organization and legal profiles, program enrollment and agreement status, Microsoft Entra ID\-linked user provisioning, role\-based permissions and workspace access, identifiers and tenant/location associations, incentives and benefits, referrals/co\-sell, marketplace workflows, activity logs, compliance controls and access troubleshooting. Candidates without demonstrable hands\-on Microsoft Partner Center experience should not progress beyond initial screening.
* Ability to support operating models, KPI frameworks, governance routines, executive reporting packs, portfolio views and decision materials for senior stakeholders.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management and follow\-through skills in a matrixed, cross\-geo environment.
* Analytical and financial acumen, with comfort interpreting utilization, investment, program performance, pipeline influence and business impact data.
* Ability to manage ambiguity, competing priorities, high\-impact requests and sensitive business information with maturity, accuracy and ownership.
* Advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Office tools, including Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint and Power BI; familiarity with Power Platform, Fabric and reporting automation is preferred.
* Ability to apply AI\-enabled tools responsibly for status reporting, executive summaries, insight generation, automation, content acceleration and productivity improvement while following EY guidelines.
* Strong attention to detail, documentation discipline, process mindset and commitment to continuous improvement.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Mandatory gateway requirement: demonstrable, hands\-on Microsoft Partner Center administration experience in a complex partner organization. This capability is non\-negotiable and will carry the highest weighting in candidate shortlisting, technical assessment and final selection.
* University graduate or postgraduate qualification; specialization in Business Administration, Finance, Technology, Engineering, Economics, Management or a related field would be preferred.
* 12\+ years of experience in alliance operations, partner operations, PMO, program governance, commercial operations, reporting, business transformation or ecosystem support.
* Prior experience supporting Microsoft, technology alliances, partner programs, professional services organizations or global matrix environments would be preferred.
* Evidence of Microsoft Partner Center proficiency through specific examples of maintaining account and program configurations, coordinating user access and role assignments, monitoring enrollments and agreements, resolving access or configuration issues, and supporting incentives, benefits, referrals/co\-sell, marketplace and compliance activities. Evaluation should prioritize the candidate’s depth of ownership, recency of experience, scale and complexity of the environment, problem\-solving approach and understanding of controls.
* Experience coordinating cross\-functional workstreams, maintaining governance routines, managing trackers and preparing stakeholder\-ready reporting outputs.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Microsoft credentials or training relevant to Partner Center, Cloud Partner Program operations, Security, Azure, Modern Work or Business Applications; Project/Program Management, Agile, Strategy, Portfolio Management, Business Analysis or Business Transformation certification would be an additional advantage.
* Hands\-on exposure to Microsoft partner programs, marketplace/co\-sell motions, investments, incentives, benefits realization, specialization readiness or partner\-led governance models.
* Experience creating executive\-ready dashboards, program scorecards, leadership review packs, portfolio summaries and decision support materials.
* Exposure to automation, workflow optimization, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, Copilot or AI\-enabled productivity tools in an enterprise environment.


**Technologies and Tools**

* Microsoft Excel and Power BI for trackers, budget monitoring, KPI reporting, dashboarding, performance analysis and leadership updates.
* Microsoft Planner, Project, Lists or equivalent work management tools for milestone tracking, action logs, RAID management, approval workflows and dependency tracking.
* Microsoft Partner Center administration across account settings, organization and legal profiles, program enrollments, agreements, user management, Microsoft Entra ID\-linked role and workspace permissions, identifiers, tenants and locations, incentives and benefits, referrals/co\-sell, marketplace and AppSource, activity logs, access troubleshooting and compliance evidence.

* Microsoft Copilot or other EY\-approved AI\-enabled tools for research, meeting summarization, stakeholder updates, content drafting, insight generation and productivity improvement, in line with EY guidelines.
* Location: India – Kochi, Trivandrum or Bengaluru preferred
* Working Hours: Aligned to Americas and Global Microsoft Alliance stakeholder coverage, especially for US ET or CT work timings; flexibility may be required for global leadership forums and cross\-time\-zone collaboration.


**What We Offer**

We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

title: Program Manager
description:

Milestone is focused on building an employee\-first, performance\-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category\-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short\-term and long\-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people\-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry\-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 The Program Manager coordinates Milestone's contribution across multiple concurrent workstreams and acts as the primary point of contact for the Client program owner. This is a working seat, not a reporting seat. The role is expected to operate at task level as readily as at management level, and to step into analytical work directly where a workstream needs throughput.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

* Coordinate Milestone resources across multiple concurrent functional workstreams, maintaining sequencing, dependencies and priority alignment.
* Serve as the day\-to\-day point of contact for the Client program owner and workstream leads on resourcing, progress and escalation.
* Maintain the consolidated view of activity, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions and actions across all assigned workstreams.
* Prepare and present consolidated status reporting on the agreed cadence.
* Work directly at task level — including analysis, requirements gathering, data review and user acceptance testing support — where a workstream requires additional capacity.
* Identify capacity, sequencing and quality concerns early and surface them transparently to Client stakeholders.
* Coordinate onboarding, access provisioning and induction for incoming Milestone resources.
* Support quarterly resource planning, including forward visibility of ramp\-up and ramp\-down requirements.
* Maintain continuity of program knowledge through documented decisions and structured handover.


**Required Experience**
* 11\+ years of project or program management experience, including concurrent management of multiple workstreams on a large\-scale transformation program.
* Demonstrated hands\-on orientation — comfortable working at task level and directly contributing to analytical and requirements activity, not solely coordinating.
* Experience managing delivery across blended onshore and offshore teams.
* Experience working with third\-party system integrators and within a matrixed client environment.
* Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, root\-cause analysis and conflict\-resolution capability.
* Experience delivering within a regulated environment with formal governance and documentation expectations.
* Willingness to work a dedicated shift pattern providing overlap with US Eastern business hours.
* Experience working within GxP\-regulated environments.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience on an enterprise learning, HR or comparable platform transition.
* Agile or scrum delivery experience and relevant certification.
* Prior life sciences or pharmaceutical sector experience.


 Ways of working
   

  

* Works to the direction and priorities set by the assigned Client workstream lead or program owner.
* Maintains transparent, timely status against assigned activities and escalates blockers early rather than at the point of impact.
* Documents decisions, actions and open items so that context is held in the program record and not solely with the individual.
* Cross\-trains across adjacent functional areas to provide coverage redundancy within the Milestone team.


 Compliance and environment
   

  

* Works entirely within Client's systems, tools and environments. No client data is moved to, stored in or processed on external tooling without Client's express written approval.
* Operates within a GxP\-regulated environment and follows Client's data privacy, data integrity, information security and records\-retention standards at all times.
* Completes all Client\-mandated onboarding, access provisioning and compliance training before commencing project activity.
* Participates in Milestone's structured program induction covering program context, stakeholder map, ways of working and tooling.


**Compensation**
 Estimated Pay Range:
   

  

 Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.
   

  

****Our Commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion****
 At Milestone we strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and work with, where we all feel empowered to bring our full, authentic selves to work. We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.
   

  

 Milestone Technologies provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law, or local ordinance. Milestone also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled applicants and employees.
   

  

 We welcome the unique background, culture, experiences, knowledge, innovation, self\-expression and perspectives you can bring to our global community. Our recruitment team is looking forward to meeting you.

 It has come to our attention that unauthorized individuals and entities are impersonating Milestone Technologies, Inc. on various job boards/portals,
 **specifically Naukri.com and Linkedin.com**
**Please be advised of the following official Milestone Technologies recruitment policies:**
**Official Communication Channels**
 All legitimate email communications from our recruitment team will originate ONLY from the domains:
 **@milestone.tech.** 
 We do not use generic email services (e.g. @gmail.com, @yahoo.com, @outlook.com) or unofficial third party messaging apps to conduct formal business.
   

  

**No Recruitment Fees**

title: Architectural Design Manager
description:
**Architectural Design Manager** 




**trueceil™ \| Built Above Standard** 




  





**Location: Kerala** 




**Employment Type: Full\-Time** 




**Experience: 3\-5 Years** 




**Department: Design \& Product Development** 




**Industry: Architectural Products \| Building Materials \| Interior Systems** 




  





**ABOUT trueceil™** 




**trueceil™ is an emerging architectural ceiling systems brand focused on delivering high\-quality, design\-led metal ceiling solutions for modern commercial, institutional and interior spaces.** 




**We believe a ceiling is more than a finishing element. It can shape proportion, create rhythm, influence acoustics, define visual character and become an integral part of architectural expression.** 




**As trueceil™ grows, we are looking for an Architectural Design Manager who can help translate this philosophy into real projects, products and design solutions.** 




  





**THE ROLE** 




**The Architectural Design Manager will lead the design thinking behind trueceil™, from understanding how architects and designers use ceiling systems to developing compelling applications, technical solutions and new product opportunities.** 




**This is not a conventional drafting role.** 




**You will work across architecture, interior design, product development, technical detailing, visualisation and market engagement, helping position trueceil™ as a design\-led architectural systems brand.** 




**You will collaborate closely with architects, interior designers, consultants, contractors, sales and product teams to develop solutions that are both visually compelling and technically practical.** 




  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Architectural \& Ceiling Design** 



* **Develop ceiling concepts and design solutions using trueceil™ systems.**
* **Create reflected ceiling plans, layouts, sections, details and design proposals.**
* **Explore different applications of metal ceiling systems across commercial, hospitality, healthcare, retail, institutional and other spaces.**
* **Translate architectural intent into practical ceiling solutions.**
* **Assist architects and designers in selecting suitable trueceil™ systems, patterns, finishes and configurations.**
* **Develop design alternatives based on aesthetics, performance, budget and installation requirements.**



**Product \& Design Development** 



* **Identify opportunities for new ceiling systems, configurations, finishes and applications.**
* **Work with the product team to develop and refine new trueceil™ products.**
* **Explore new applications for existing systems such as Lay\-In, Clip\-In, Open Cell, Baffle and Linear ceilings.**
* **Develop custom design concepts and solutions for specific projects.**
* **Study industry trends, architectural materials and emerging ceiling design approaches.**
* **Convert design opportunities and market feedback into potential product\-development ideas.**



**Technical Design \& Documentation** 



* **Prepare and review technical drawings, ceiling details and installation concepts.**
* **Develop design documentation for architects, consultants and project teams.**
* **Support preparation of product specifications, technical submittals and project documentation.**
* **Coordinate with estimation and technical teams to ensure designs are commercially and technically feasible.**
* **Review drawings and identify potential installation or coordination issues before execution.**



**Architect \& Designer Engagement** 



* **Present trueceil™ products and design solutions to architects, interior designers and consultants.**
* **Conduct product presentations, design discussions and technical sessions.**
* **Understand the design requirements of architectural practices and translate them into trueceil™ solutions.**
* **Build meaningful professional relationships within the architecture and interior design community.**
* **Support the business development team in project identification and specification opportunities.**



**Visualisation \& Brand Communication** 



* **Develop high\-quality design presentations showcasing trueceil™ applications.**
* **Coordinate 3D visualisations, renders and product application imagery.**
* **Contribute to catalogues, brochures, product presentations and design guides.**
* **Help communicate complex technical products through clear and compelling visual design.**
* **Work with the brand team to create design\-led content that demonstrates what trueceil™ can achieve.**



  





**WHAT YOU'LL OWN** 




**Design Direction** 




**How trueceil™ systems are presented and applied across architectural spaces.** 




**Product Applications** 




**How existing and future trueceil™ products can be used creatively and practically.** 




**Technical Design** 




**How concepts are translated into buildable ceiling solutions.** 




**Architect Engagement** 




**How trueceil™ supports architects and designers from concept through specification.** 




**Design Innovation** 




**Identifying new opportunities where trueceil™ can create better architectural solutions.** 




  





**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 



* **Bachelor's or Master's degree in Architecture, Interior Design, Product Design or a related discipline.**
* **4–8 years of relevant professional experience.**
* **Strong understanding of architectural and interior design principles.**
* **Experience with ceiling systems, interior products, building materials or architectural products will be an advantage.**
* **Strong understanding of construction detailing and material applications.**
* **Ability to read and interpret architectural and engineering drawings.**
* **Strong design sense with attention to proportion, geometry, materiality and detail.**
* **Ability to balance aesthetics with technical and commercial requirements.**
* **Excellent presentation and communication skills.**
* **Ability to work independently as well as coordinate with multiple teams.**


- 


**SOFTWARE SKILLS** 




**Proficiency in relevant design and documentation software such as:** 




**AutoCAD \| Revit \| SketchUp \| 3D Visualisation Software \| Adobe Creative Suite** 




**Knowledge of Rhino, Grasshopper, 3ds Max, Blender, Lumion, Enscape or similar tools will be an advantage.** 




  





**THE IDEAL CANDIDATE** 




**We are looking for someone who doesn't see a ceiling as simply a grid and a panel.** 




**You notice lines, proportions, rhythm, light, shadow, acoustics, materiality and detail.** 




**You can look at an architectural drawing and think beyond what is shown, to understand how the ceiling can contribute to the space.** 




**You are equally comfortable discussing a design concept with an architect, developing a technical detail with an engineer, exploring a new product with a manufacturer, or presenting a solution to a client.** 




**Most importantly, you want to build something, not simply maintain something that already exists.** 




  





**WHY JOIN trueceil™?** 



* **Be part of an emerging architectural products brand.**
* **Work across architecture, design, product development and business.**
* **Help shape the design language and product applications of trueceil™.**
* **Work directly with architects, designers, consultants and project teams.**
* **Opportunity to contribute to new product development and innovation.**
* **Take ownership of projects and ideas from concept to application.**
* **Grow with a brand that aims to raise the standard of architectural ceiling systems.**



  





**If you believe the ceiling is part of the architecture, not just the space above it, we'd like to meet you.** 




**Apply Now \| trueceil™ – Built Above Standard**

title: Cluster Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 T.I.M.E. Kids is a growing preschool brand operating under the T.I.M.E. group, a well\-established name in the education sector in India. Headquartered in Secunderabad, Andhra Pradesh, T.I.M.E. Kids focuses on delivering structured, quality\-driven learning experiences for young students. The organization is known for its standardized curriculum, child\-centric teaching methods, and strong emphasis on holistic development. Team members benefit from working in a professional academic environment with clear processes, training support, and opportunities to contribute to long\-term educational impact.

 The Cluster Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Kochi for one of its franchise partner named Daffodils. The person will be responsible for overseeing 5 T.I.M.E. **Job Listing Detail**
 At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We’re looking for a Manager in our Cyber Security team with a strong focus on Data Protection and Privacy Platforms Engineering. This role is centered on the implementation, engineering, integration, and administration of enterprise scale data protection and privacy technologies, helping organizations protect sensitive data across endpoints, networks, cloud, applications, and AI enabled platforms.
   

  

 You will work closely with clients to design and operationalize Data Loss Prevention (DLP), data discovery and classification, privacy management platforms, and privacy enhancing technologies (PETs)—enabling compliant, secure, and trusted use of data in modern digital and AI driven environments.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the design, implementation, and engineering of enterprise data protection and privacy platforms, including DLP, data discovery, classification, and privacy tooling.
* Implement and administer Data Loss Prevention (DLP) solutions across endpoint, email, network, cloud, and SaaS environments.
* Design and operationalize data discovery and data classification programs, enabling visibility into sensitive data across structured and unstructured sources.
* Engineer and integrate privacy platforms supporting consent management, data subject rights (DSR/DSAR), records of processing, and privacy workflows.
* Implement and support Privacy Enhancing Technologies (PETs) such as tokenization, pseudonymization, anonymization, encryption, and data masking.
* Integrate data protection and privacy platforms with cloud, data, and AI ecosystems, including data lakes, analytics platforms, and AI/ML pipelines.
* Manage Microsoft Purview Information Protection (Labeling) for data classification, sensitivity labeling, and policy enforcement
* Configure and manage policy driven controls aligned with regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, regional privacy laws) and organizational data governance standards.

 The Ocean Freight Operations team plays a pivotal role in managing all ocean\-bound imports and exports, utilizing a diverse range of equipment and services. The team collaborates closely with a network of ocean carriers, Procurement \& capacity management (PCM), and participating in major carrier alliances to secure planned space protection from key container ports globally. This meticulous coordination is essential for ensuring a reliable and efficient transportation process for ocean\-bound cargo.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As the Manager of Ocean Freight Export/Import Operations, this role involves overseeing and improving operational activities related to Ocean Freight Export/Import. * Ensure operational compliance and error\-free documentation.
* Procure and manage cargo capacity cost\-effectively, overseeing all port operations.
* Ensure the smooth execution of export shipments in line with customer requirements, country regulations, and customs trade practices.

* Efficiently manage customer complaints.
* Identify and address possible gaps to eliminate revenue leakages.
* Avoid claims and penalties due to service failures.

* Oversee vendor payment process.
* Conduct customer visits as and when required.
* Ensure timely submission of management reports.
* Support and encourage the BC specialization.
* Oversee gateway operations.
* Drive implementation of key initiatives.
* Drive and implement the First\-Choice initiative as assigned.
* Taking charge of supervising the team members for all relevant operations, efficiency optimization, and upholding the standards outlined in the 1F1O (one file, one operator) methodology.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Manage customer relationships and address grievances.
* Manage relationships with carriers, suppliers, and the network.
* Interface with sales and customer service teams.


**Team Management**
* Develop a culture of quality, service excellence, flexibility, and cost consciousness.
* Develop IKOs/KPIs with team members and monitor individual performance.
