At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Team**
 EY Strategy Execution \& Operations (SE\&O)
   

  

**Role Title(s)**
 Senior Analyst \- FS Audit Intelligence, Analytics \& Automation
   

  

**The Role**
**Senior Analyst \- GFS Audit Intelligence, Analytics \& Automation** 
 serves as a strategic enabler of data\-driven governance, audit intelligence, and process digitization. This role is responsible for delivering actionable insights, market intelligence, and automated reporting solutions that support audit fee pricing, audit rotation strategies, auditor market share analysis, and portfolio mix account governance and process.
   

  

**Key responsibilities:**
* Data Management: Demonstrates a technology\-enabled continuous improvement mindset, proactively identifying opportunities to enhance processes, controls, and data management practices. Able to design and maintain structured, scalable, and well\-governed data solutions that support evolving business needs, advanced analytics, and future AI\-enabled capabilities.
* Technology capability: Strong experience managing large and complex datasets, including advanced Excel, Power BI, data transformation and automation tools (e.g., Python), with a solid understanding of data quality, governance, and reporting methodologies to support scalable analytics and insight generation.
* Analytics and insights: Establish and apply leading\-practice analytical approaches to assess audit fees, auditor rotations, market share, and related financial metrics. Act as a trusted advisor on benchmarking methodologies, data interpretation, and insight generation, ensuring analyses are consistent, defensible, and aligned with EY quality standards while supporting account strategy, governance, pursuits, and fee negotiations.
* Market and regulatory research: Perform market, regulatory, and auditor landscape research to validate data sources and methodologies, acting as a subject matter expert on external data providers and supporting the identification of credible, high\-quality sources for business insights.
* Stakeholder management: Work closely with business stakeholders to understand priorities, translate requirements into actionable deliverables, and ensure outputs align with the objectives of GFS and Global Assurance leadership. Collaborate across internal teams to leverage existing knowledge, data, methodologies, and best practices to maximise the quality and impact of insights.
* Note: This above list of activities is not exhaustive but only gives an indication of the nature of the project / scope of work.


**Research experience:**
* Understanding of how to source and validate information from public sources
* Ability to investigate less structured information and identify new sources to expand knowledge and coverage
* Understand how to use tech to support research and data extraction with a mindset to evolve and automate at all times
* General understanding of financial institutions, corporate structures, subsidiaries and regulated entities
* Ability to interpret regulatory developments and assess their impact on our data set and insights
* Familiarity with financial reporting, governance disclosures, regulatory publications and public company filings
* Experience working with Financial Services, company, regulatory, market intelligence or comparable business datasets
* Awareness of audit\-related information, including audit firms, audit fees and auditor appointments, although deep technical knowledge is not required


**Tech skills:**
* Advanced Excel skills, including advanced formulas, Pivot Tables, Power Query, Pivot, Macros and large dataset handling
* Data management \- cleansing, reconciliation, validation and quality assurance methodologies
* Experience maintaining structured datasets and continuous improvement of efficiency and optimisation (data architecture knowledge desirable)
* Power BI skills – dashboard and visuals, data modelling, DAX knowledge
* Knowledge of Power Apps and Power Automate to support workflow automation, process improvement, and low\-code solution development
* Python experience (desirable) \- data analysis, transformation, validation and automation
* AI \- understanding of AI and use of AI for improving automation of data collation / data management / insights


**Data Architecture \& Methodology:**
* Experience developing analytical models and reporting outputs to support business decision\-making
* Structured dataset and data model design, building scalable solutions that support future analytics and automation
* Data governance, documentation and control frameworks, consistent data standards, definitions and source management
* Understanding business objectives and keeping in front of mind when developing solutions and insights
* Continuous validation of deliverables against stakeholder requirements and evaluate how to evolve our solutions to support


**To qualify for the role, you must have:**
* Graduate / Post\-graduate \- (Business Administration, Information and Data Science) with 7 \- 12 years’ work experience in professional services industry having exposure working on applications and automation.
* Strong understanding of data analytics, best practices when developing solutions and experience in solution development, specifically utilizing Microsoft suite of tools.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams.


**What we look for:**
* Exceptional attention to detail and quality focus.
* Curious, investigative, and solution oriented.
* Comfortable providing recommendations and evidence\-based conclusions.
* Comfortable providing new tech solution ideas and improvements for data management and insights.
* Ability to translate analytical output into actionable recommendations for stakeholders and leadership.
* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Able to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Strong collaboration skills and a team\-oriented mindset
* Reliable, proactive and consistent in delivery.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: CBS-BMC-Creative Services -Assistant Director-Senior Art Director
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

 At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

 At EY Global Delivery Services (GDS), we work hand in hand with the business to build awareness of our services and solutions; to bring our purpose — building a better working world — to life for our people, clients and communities; to engage our people and build a high performing culture; and to build the commercial value and emotional resonance of the EY and the GDS brand.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 EY GDS Creative Center of Excellence (CoE) is an inhouse agency that helps EY teams build a better working world by delivering high\-impact, high\-quality and on–brand creative solutions. People in the CoE help create experiences that are not just creatively inspiring, but also strategically precise and deeply human — across multiple media platforms.
   

  

 As a Senior Art Director, you will have a unique blend of creative vision and strategic thinking, to lead our team and will act as a strong creative strategist and a design thought leader.
   

  

 You will own the creative and visual direction and design for creative collaterals across multiple formats, ensuring that all creatives are on\-brand, user\-centric and aesthetically proficient. With a passion for problem\-solving and creative strategy, you lead creative brainstorms with stakeholders and content and digital marketing teams to produce best\-in\-class creatives that intrinsically align with the EY brand and business objectives. With your impeccable aesthetic sense and design sensibility, you are a versatile and reliable leader who can elevate any creative conceptualization, storyboard or creative direction for projects across multiple channels.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* You understand the power of creative ideas and have a track\-record of delivering memorable ideas that shape audience perception, engagement, and participation
* You help coach and train the wider team, transforming GDS Creative Services capability from providing excellent design and execution services, to leading with brand\-building and distinctive creative ideas and strategy
* Have experience leading teams in creative agencies or in\-house brand teams, championing high\-visibility campaigns for top global brands (preferably B2B)
* Provide creative leadership to the design teams to deliver a range of collaterals (i.e., brochures, placemats, illustration, layouts, infographics, on\-screen presentations, proposals, microsites, motion graphic content and social media collaterals)
* Produce strategically sound conceptual work and bring it to life through rapid prototyping and storyboard creation and all the way through post\-production
* Adhere to EY brand guidelines, meet, and exceed defined expectations in terms of aesthetics, quality, turnaround time, budget and efficiency
* Stay up\-to\-date with current and future designs, web standards, concepts and industry trends and advocate the same to team members and customers
* Provide creative and art direction support to the team, coordinate with team members and others to resolve issues, as necessary
* Proactively identify opportunities to employ pop culture trends, creativity, executional approaches and techniques to create exceptional user experiences
* Communicate effectively with various customers/customer groups while understanding design briefs and sharing ideas
* Lead project discussions with customers with a customer\-centric mindset
* Provide unique and innovative design solutions to customers and convince them to make the right design choices
* Prioritize deadlines and effectively manage multiple creative projects parallelly
* Be a part and contribute towards various organizational initiatives


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* A user\-centric mindset with creative, innovative and analytical approach
* Working knowledge of creating infographics and data visualization techniques
* Exceptional project management, risk management and team management
* Proven track record of delivering high\-quality output on time and within budget
* An innovative mindset that takes a client problem and delivers compelling and inspiring creative solutions
* Excellent communication (comprehension, verbal and written) and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate and persuade
* Exceptional attention to detail
* Understanding of current and future visual trends


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Bachelor's degree or college diploma (preferably in Graphic Design or related discipline) \*
* Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, and Adobe InDesign, Adobe DC and Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Word and Excel)
* Experience across a range of digital, social, and integrated media
* Knowledge of social platforms (Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Pinterest etc.)
* Strong visual design and creative thinking capability
* At least 12 years of overall experience in a fast\-paced global environment
* Prior art direction experience in leading agencies


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Working knowledge of other key software and tools relevant to the industry


**What We Look For**
* Strong business acumen along with creative vision
* Creative problem\-solving mindset with a flexible can\-do attitude
* A growth mindset creative who loves to collaborate, ideate and deliver breakthrough work
* Experience in leading and managing creative teams, as well as developing junior creative talent
* Self\-starter who loves challenges and makes big things happen by working together
* Experience working with global clients
* Confidence, maturity and ability to build strong client relationships
* A strong team player who is comfortable working collaboratively with others


**What We Offer**
 EY GDS is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to creative consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Site Project Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced Civil Construction Manager to manage and supervise villa construction projects from start to completion. The candidate will be responsible for site execution, manpower coordination, quality control, material management, and ensuring timely completion of the project.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 * Manage day\-to\-day construction activities for villa projects.
* Supervise civil, structural, finishing, and external works.
* Coordinate with architects, engineers, subcontractors, suppliers, and clients.
* Read and interpret architectural, structural, and MEP drawings.
* Plan and monitor manpower, materials, equipment, and daily work activities.
* Ensure construction work follows approved drawings, specifications, and quality standards.
* Monitor project progress and ensure work is completed according to schedule.
* Conduct regular site inspections and identify and resolve construction issues.
* Coordinate different trades including masonry, plastering, tiling, waterproofing, painting, plumbing, electrical, and other finishing works.
* Monitor material requirements and control wastage.
* Maintain daily site reports, measurements, and project documentation.
* Ensure proper health and safety practices at the construction site.
* Coordinate inspections, snagging, rectification, and final handover.


 Requirements
 * Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in residential/villa construction.
* Strong knowledge of civil construction and finishing works.
* Good knowledge of drawings, measurements, BOQ, and construction materials.
* Strong leadership and site\-management skills.
* Ability to manage workers and subcontractors effectively.
* Good communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and meet project deadlines.

 Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.

 We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands\-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!
   

  

 \*SUMMARY: To co\-ordinate and perform processes associated with the configuration, maintenance and validation of databases and database systems and associated applications. \*
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 \_Tasks may include but are not limited to:\_
   

  

 To liaise with relevant staff to determine the allocation of tasks, to establish timelines, to report progress and any issues outstanding.
   

  

 To assist in training and mentoring Clinical Database Programmers in the configuration of databases and development, testing and running of SAS programs.
   

  

 To assist in training and mentoring Data Management staff in the specification of databases and SAS programs.
   

  

 To review specifications for the set\-up and modification of project specific data entry software (including edit check specifications).
   

  

 Review validation plan for edit check and reconciliation check specifications.
   

  

 Develop, test and run SAS programs for clinical data management. This includes programs for data validation and reconciliation checks, data listings and data transfers.
   

  

 To configure database/eDC software (both internal and 3rd party) for the use of DM, sponsor and sites.
   

  

 To perform testing of databases and related applications according to IT and Data Management departmental SOPs, both for initial set\-up and maintenance.
   

  

 To run database upload programs and to process any error reports.
   

  

 To liaise with 3rd party vendors to resolve issues, implement changes to software.
   

  

 To liaise with Sponsors or their designates on matters associated with the transfer of electronic data to or from the company, as defined by the Director, Data Management.
   

  

 To support Data Management in the production and maintenance of system procedures and documentation in accordance with applicable SOPs.
   

  

 Assist with Quality Assurance and Audit requirements.
   

  

 Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed above are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all\-inclusive.
   

  

 \*OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES: \*
   

  

 Be able to demonstrate good written and verbal communication skills.
   

  

 Be able to demonstrate a methodical and logical approach to problem solving and the ability to learn new tasks quickly.
   

  

 Be able to work with close attention to detail.
   

  

 Be questioning about the validity of data being entered/extracted.
   

  

 Be hardworking and efficient.
   

  

 Possess good team working skills.
   

  

 Key competencies in customer focus, delivering on commitments, building strong relationships, communicating and influencing, and embracing innovation and change.
   

  

 The job holder must be computer literate and numerate with a willingness to adapt to various computer systems.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Be educated to degree level or relevant experience
   

  

 At least 5 years experience of Data Management Systems and Software
   

  

 An understanding of CDISC SDTM standards
   

  

 Experience of SAS programming language
   

  

 Promotion to the next level is not automatic based on years of experience. Personnel are evaluated on proven competency, level of responsibility, and ability to work independently.

title: Senior Contracts Manager
description:
**Department:** 
 Commercial / Contracts
 



**Direct report:** 
 Contract Manager/Contract Assistant
 



**Key interfaces:** 
 Senior leadership, Project Directors, Business Development, Finance, \& Bid Management Reporting), Legal advisers, Insurers, Clients, Sub\-Consultants
 



  





**ROLE PURPOSE** 




 The Senior Contracts Manager leads the company's contracts function and is accountable for how it manages contractual and commercial risk. The role sets the contract strategy, standards and governance for the team, negotiates and approves key contract terms, leads on variations, claims and disputes, and makes sure management receives accurate, timely contract information to support decisions.
 



  





 The Senior Contracts Manager line\-manages the Contract Manager/Assistant. Day\-to\-day contract administration is delegated to the Contract Manager, while the Senior Contracts Manager provides oversight, assistance with Contractual Agreements, approval, escalation and development of the team.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





**Contract Strategy and Commercial Risk** 



* Review and advise on the contract terms of major bids and awards before signature, including scope, fees, payment terms, liability caps, indemnities, insurance, intellectual property and termination provisions.
* Lead negotiations with clients on high\-value, high\-risk or non\-standard contracts, and recommend acceptance, qualification or rejection of terms to senior leadership.
* Establish and maintain the company's risk appetite for contract terms, including approval thresholds and escalation routes.



  





**Governance, Standards and Approvals** 



* Own the company's standard contract templates, including SCAs, LOAs, PO terms and standard qualifications for proposals.
* Approve contracts, sub\-consultant agreements and variations above the Contract Manager's delegated authority.
* Set and enforce contract procedures, record\-keeping standards and data quality rules across the contract, award, bid and finance trackers, Cleverflow and Metabase.
* Carry out periodic audits of contract records and trackers to confirm accuracy and compliance.



  





**Variations, Claims and Disputes** 



* Lead the company's position on significant variation orders (VOs), fee adjustments, extensions of time and claims, making sure entitlement is protected and properly documented.
* Manage contractual disputes with clients and sub\-consultants, working with legal advisers where needed, and aim for negotiated resolution.
* Ensure lessons learned from disputes and claims feed back into contract templates and bid qualifications.



  





**Management Reporting and Decision Support** 



* Sign off the contract and award data prepared for the
 **weekly Wednesday management meeting** 
 , and present key issues, risks and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Give senior leadership oversight of the award pipeline, contract status, outstanding contracts and commercial exposure.
* Work with Finance leadership so that contract status and VO information support accurate WIP, revenue forecasting and cash\-flow planning.



  





**Stakeholder Management** 



* Act as the senior contractual point of contact for key clients, and the escalation point for long\-outstanding contracts or disputed matters.
* Manage relationships with legal advisers and insurers, including professional indemnity insurance requirements under client contracts.
* Support the Head of Bids and Business Development on the contractual aspects of bids, frameworks and joint ventures.



  





**Team Leadership and Development** 



* Line\-manage the Contract Manager, setting objectives, reviewing performance and supporting professional development.
* Oversee workload across the contracts team so that recurring deadlines (Friday bid tracker, Wednesday management pack) are consistently met.
* Build contract awareness across project teams through guidance and training on key contract obligations.
* Plan for resourcing and succession in the contracts function as the business grows.



  





**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS** 




  




* Contract execution \- Percentage of awarded projects with fully executed contracts within the target period
* Commercial risk \- Contracts signed within approved risk parameters; number of exceptions approved
* Data accuracy \- Reconciliation discrepancies between, Cleverflow Metabase, trackers and finance records
* Reporting \- Management pack and bid tracker delivered on time every week
* Variations and claims \- Value and timeliness of VOs agreed; claims recovered
* Disputes \- Number, duration and outcome of contractual disputes
* Team \- Team performance, development and retention



  





**REQUIREMENTS** 




  





**Education and Experience** 



* Bachelor's degree in Quantity Surveying, Engineering, Construction Management, Law or a related field. A postgraduate qualification in construction law or contract management is an advantage.
* 10–15 years of experience in contract or commercial management, including at least 5 years in a senior or team\-leading role, ideally within an engineering, design or construction consultancy.
* Proven track record of negotiating consultancy agreements and managing variations, claims and disputes.
* Substantial GCC/UAE experience, including work with government and major developer clients.



  





**Professional Membership (Desirable)** 



* MRICS, MCIArb, FIDIC certification, or equivalent professional recognition.



  





**Knowledge and Skills** 



* Expert knowledge of consultancy and construction contract forms, including the FIDIC suite (particularly the White Book for consultancy services) and bespoke client agreements.
* Good understanding of UAE/KSA contract and commercial law principles, professional indemnity insurance and liability management.
* Strong negotiation, influencing and stakeholder management skills at senior level.
* Ability to interpret financial and commercial data and link it to contract positions.
* Strong leadership and coaching skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including preparation of board\-level reports.



  





**Personal Attributes** 



* Commercially astute, with sound judgement on risk.
* Calm and decisive under pressure, particularly in negotiations and disputes.
* Sets high standards for accuracy and governance,and leads by example.

title: Manager - Tax – Internal Tax Operations
description:
**Position Profile**
 Weaver is looking for talented tax manager to join our growing firm! The Internal Tax Operations team supports the tax\-related activity of Weaver and its partners. This includes the firm’s partnership return, state and international tax compliance, and individual partner tax returns.
   

  

 The tax manager will primarily support the tax compliance process for Weaver partners, including oversight of return preparation, technical review, and workflow management. This role will also assist with firm\-level tax compliance activities and collaborate closely with U.S.\-based tax professionals to ensure timely delivery and high\-quality service.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
  

  

* Partner Tax Compliance Leadership
+ Manage end\-to\-end tax compliance process for Weaver partner individual tax returns.
+ Supervise, mentor, and develop associates and senior associates supporting the partner tax compliance process
+ Coordinate workflow between US teams and India\-based tax professionals.
+ Monitor project status, budgets, workloads and deadlines to ensure timely delivery during busy season.

* Technical Review
+ Perform first\-level technical review of complex federal and state individual income tax returns prepared by associates and senior associates.
+ Identify technical issues and provide guidance to team members regarding federal and state tax matters.

* Internal Tax Operations Support
+ Review reports, schedules, and supporting workpapers for the firm’s partnership, state, and other tax filings.
+ Assist with special projects and process improvement initiatives related to Internal Tax Operations.

* Seasonal Client Service Support
+ During non\-peak partner compliance periods, assist the Private Client Services teams serving high\-net\-worth individual clients.


**To be successful in this role, the following qualifications are required:**
* Bachelor’s degree in accounting or related field
* CPA with 5\+ years of experience in federal tax compliance, planning and consulting at a public accounting firm with a focus on high\-net\-worth individuals, partnerships, and closely held businesses
* Experience reviewing complex Forms 1040 returns, partnership and flow\-through reporting, and supervising tax compliance workflows within a public accounting environment
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across global teams


**Additionally, The Following Qualifications Are Preferred**
* Master’s degree in accounting or related field
* Experience with multi\-state tax compliance
* Proven ability to manage, mentor and develop staff
* Experience working with US\-based public accounting firms in a global delivery environment

title: Project Manager
company: SGBI INC - Sastra Global Business Innovations
description:
**Location:** 
 Cochin, Kerala (Primarily in\-office, with occasional travel)
 



**Role Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





**About SGBI Inc (Sastra Robotics)** 




 SGBI Inc is a Silicon Valley\-based robotics and AI company operating across the USA, UK and India. We are building next\-generation Physical AI systems that combine AI, robotics, computer vision and intelligent software to automate quality assurance of both software and hardware in smart devices.
 



 Our flagship platform, QUACO (Quality Assurance Companion), enables AI\-driven, robot\-aided testing of Human\-Machine Interfaces (HMIs), bridging the gap between digital intelligence and real\-world systems.
 



 We work with global enterprise customers across industries such as retail, banking, automotive, consumer electronics, avionics and medical, helping them accelerate product validation for complex, hardware\-dependent software and physical products.
 



**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a high\-ownership Project Manager to run delivery across our full project portfolio: new product development, software releases, customer deployments and hardware production.
 



 You will be the single point of truth on what is being delivered, by whom and by when. You will plan the work, run the review rhythm, keep our project tools accurate, track and report delivery KPIs, and hold teams and vendors to their commitments, flagging risks to leadership before they become problems.
 



 You will work closely with the founders, engineering leads and our customers and integration partners in the UK, US and Middle East.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Project Portfolio Management** 



* Own the portfolio of active projects across R\&D, software, customer engineering and production.
* Maintain accurate phase, status, priority, milestones, ETAs, dependencies and next actions for every project.
* Publish a clear weekly portfolio view to leadership, with RAG status and the decisions needed.



  





**2\. KPI Tracking \& Reporting** 



* Define and maintain delivery KPIs such as on\-time milestone delivery, schedule variance, overdue task ageing, change request volume, customer issue resolution time, production cycle time and FQC first\-pass yield.
* Build and maintain live KPI dashboards in ClickUp and Excel / Google Sheets, with data that is accurate and up to date.
* Produce weekly and monthly reports for leadership, concise summaries suitable for board and investor updates, and status reports for customers.
* Analyse trends, identify root causes of delays or recurring issues, and recommend corrective actions.
* Provide objective delivery data to support team performance reviews, working with HR.
* Use AI tools such as Claude, Google Gemini or ChatGPT to research, analyse data and prepare clear, well\-structured reports and presentations for stakeholders.



  





**3\. Planning \& Execution** 



* Plan projects from requirement to release using a phase\-gated lifecycle, with defined owners, milestones and deliverables at each stage.
* Maintain the project document checklist for each phase and ensure documents are produced and approved on time.
* Manage scope and change requests, assessing impact on timelines, cost and resources before they are accepted.



  





**4\. Resource \& Capacity Management** 



* Know who is working on what, their next assignment and their expected availability.
* Plan capacity across concurrent projects that share people, test units and equipment, and resolve conflicts early.
* Raise resourcing gaps to leadership with clear options and trade\-offs.



  





**5\. Review \& Governance Rhythm** 



* Run the daily, weekly and monthly review cadence across teams.
* Follow up on overdue tasks and blockers persistently until they are closed.
* Record decisions, actions and owners, and make sure they are carried through.



  





**6\. ClickUp Governance** 



* Own ClickUp as the single source of truth for project work: spaces and lists, task structure, custom fields, status flows, bugs, due dates, dashboards and access.
* Set and enforce usage standards so that status in the tool always reflects reality, including handling of overdue items.
* Build dashboards that give leadership an at\-a\-glance view of delivery health.



  





**7\. Customer Governance** 



* Manage delivery commitments to enterprise customers and integration partners: contacts, milestones, pending actions, change requests and issues.
* Maintain the evidence and communication trail and document trackers for each customer engagement.
* Prepare customer status updates and coordinate deployments, installations and site visits, including international logistics.



  





**8\. Production Coordination** 



* Track the production plan for robot units end to end: materials, procurement, stock, assembly, final quality check (FQC) and shipment.
* Work with Procurement, Stores, QA and Assembly to keep builds on schedule, and manage vendor and lead\-time risks.
* Maintain a production dependency checklist and flag shortages or delays early.



  





**What Success Looks Like in the First 6 Months** 



* Every active project is visible in ClickUp with accurate status, owners and dates.
* A KPI dashboard is live and reported monthly, and leadership uses it to make decisions.
* The daily, weekly and monthly review rhythm runs consistently, with overdue items actively followed up.
* Every customer commitment is tracked with an owner and a date, and customers receive regular, reliable updates.
* Production builds are tracked from materials to shipment, with risks raised before they cause delays.
* Leadership has fewer surprises: delays and conflicts are flagged early, with options.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* 6\+ years of project management experience, including delivery of technology products that combine hardware and software.
* Proven experience running multiple concurrent projects with shared resources.
* Experience managing delivery for enterprise customers, including change requests and escalations.
* Strong working knowledge of project tools such as ClickUp, Jira or Asana (ClickUp preferred), and of Excel or Google Sheets.
* Hands\-on experience defining KPIs and building dashboards and reports: advanced Excel / Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups, charts) and project tool dashboards.
* Able to turn data into clear, concise insight for senior leadership, not just raw numbers.
* Proficiency in AI tools (essential): confident, day\-to\-day use of tools such as Claude, Google Gemini or ChatGPT for research, analysis, drafting and building stakeholder presentations. This will be assessed during the interview.
* Understanding of hardware production: procurement, lead times, stock, assembly and quality checks.
* Excellent written and verbal English; able to write clear status reports for leadership and customers.
* Firm, persistent follow\-up; comfortable holding senior engineers and vendors to commitments.
* Willingness to take occasional calls outside Indian working hours with UK and US teams, and a valid passport for occasional travel.
* Engineering degree (BE / B.Tech) preferred.



  





**What Will Make You Stand Out** 



* **Experience in robotics, automation, embedded or electromechanical product companies.**
* **Experience with phase\-gated (stage\-gate) new product development.**
* **Having set up project governance or tooling from scratch in a startup.**
* **Experience working with system integrators or channel partners.**
* **Exposure to ERP systems such as Odoo for stock and procurement.**
* **Experience with BI tools such as Looker Studio or Power BI.**
* **PMP, PRINCE2 or Agile / Scrum certification.**



  





**Important Note** 




 This role is suited for someone who
 **drives delivery** 
 , not someone who only tracks it. You will be expected to chase, challenge and escalate, and to own outcomes across teams. If you are looking for a purely coordination or administrative role, this may not be the right fit.
 



 Practical proficiency with AI tools is a
 **core requirement for every role at SGBI** 
 . Candidates without it will not be considered.

* reset, reimagine and re\-think their business and operating models with tech\-enabled, cutting\-edge solutions that re\-energize performance across the enterprise
* set and drive enterprise tech vision and strategy in alignment with corporate / business unit strategy, customer focus and solution teams

Working closely with our industry groups and leveraging the Ernst \& Young brand as independent, trusted advisors, we provide our high\-profile clients with range of services including:
   

  

* Tech Strategy \& Vision
* IT Operating Model optimization
* 3/5\-year Transformation strategy, roadmaps \& blueprints
* Office of CIO functions (IT Finance, Sourcing, Project Portfolio Mgt. etc)
* Product strategy \& management
* M\&A due\-diligence, planning and post integration/separation

* Analyze value chain and business capabilities to develop clear understanding of strategic objectives, KPI’s, processes and underlying systems that deliver the business outcomes
* Assess the impact of the business strategy on business capability model and business processes to identify optimization opportunities (through tech\-enabled solutions) across organization, systems, data, infrastructure and applications

title: BIM Manager
description:

Arangath partners with clients to improve project outcomes through precise information management, efficient design coordination, and robust digital workflows.

title: Lead Business Systems Analyst
description:
**Company Overview**
 Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee\-first, performance\-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category\-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
   

  

 Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short\-term and long\-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people\-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry\-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 Requirements ownership (approx. 80%)
   

  

* Own requirements end to end for Module 3 enablement — elicitation, documentation, prioritisation, traceability from business objective through to delivered capability and acceptance.
* Act as the translator between HEOR business stakeholders and the AI\&D and platform engineering teams: convert domain and workflow need into requirements the engineers can build against, and convert technical constraints back into decisions the business can actually make.
* Plan and lead requirements definition working sessions and workshops, bringing the Lead AI Engineer in where feasibility needs to be assessed live rather than discovered later.
* Work with business SMEs to surface nuanced requirements that differ across sections and content types, and document them at a level of precision an engineer can act on without a follow\-up conversation.
* Define acceptance criteria for AI\-generated content — factual grounding, source traceability, completeness against the section template, tone and terminology consistency — in terms the business owns and the engineers can test against.
* Build on the substantial documentation already produced through the POC work rather than restarting discovery. Establish quickly what is complete, what remains, and what is at risk.
* Refine requirements iteratively across the execution period as SME review cycles reveal what the platform can and cannot yet do, without losing the thread of what was originally agreed.


 Delivery coordination (approx. 20%)
   

  

* Hold the pod’s delivery cadence: backlog, sprint rhythm, stand\-ups and review cycles, run in the client’s tooling.
* Sequence work realistically against actual capacity and state clearly what can and cannot be delivered within the pilot window.
* Own weekly progress and status reporting to Amgen — at a level of candour that surfaces problems while they are still cheap to fix.
* Identify, log and escalate blockers, risks and dependencies early, particularly those sitting with the core APEX build team, with source\-content availability, or with SME review capacity.
* Maintain the risk, issue, decision and assumption log for the engagement.


 Stakeholder leadership
   

  

* Hold the day\-to\-day relationship with HEOR subject\-matter experts and the wider business group, and be the single point they come to for scope and progress.
* Coordinate across the three organisations involved — HEOR, AI\&D and the platform team — without formal authority over any of them.
* Push back on requirements, scope additions and timeline expectations where the evidence warrants, with reasoning rather than resistance.
* Protect the engineers’ focus: absorb coordination load, filter noise, and ensure they receive requirements that are decided rather than still being argued.
* Document and hand over requirements, decisions and open items in a form the Amgen team can own after the pilot.


**Required Qualifications**
* Experience. 10\+ years in business analysis, business systems analysis or a comparable requirements\-owning role, including a minimum of 3 years on AI, GenAI, machine learning or intelligent\-automation programmes.
* AI lifecycle fluency. Demonstrable experience across the full AI delivery lifecycle — not a single pilot. Practical understanding of hallucination, non\-determinism, human\-in\-the\-loop requirements and output variability, and how each changes the way requirements must be written.
* Hands\-on GenAI literacy. Working familiarity with GPT/Claude\-class tooling — enough to understand how prompting, templatisation and output structuring work, and to hold a credible conversation with engineers about what is and is not achievable.
* Requirements craft. Strong elicitation technique, functional and non\-functional specification, acceptance criteria, and traceability discipline across multiple interconnected workstreams.
* Workshop leadership. Proven ability to plan and lead requirements workshops with senior, non\-technical business stakeholders and drive them to decisions rather than discussion.
* Delivery discipline. Experience running an agile delivery cadence — backlog, sprints, status reporting, risk and dependency management — for a small team.
* Influence without authority. A track record of holding multiple organisations to commitments from outside all of them, evidenced by unblocking programmes rather than documenting them.
* Autonomy. Demonstrated ability to own a workstream and set its working practices without close supervision, in a client\-facing setting.
* Tooling. Proficiency with Jira; familiarity with Smartsheet and SharePoint.
* Communication. Excellent written and verbal English, at the standard required to write for and present to senior commercial stakeholders in the US and Europe, and to disagree constructively.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior delivery within a life sciences, pharmaceutical or biotech commercial organisation — market access, HEOR, medical affairs or commercial analytics. Useful context, but not a screening filter.
* Experience with AI\-assisted document authoring, content generation, knowledge management or large\-scale content transformation.
* Exposure to retrieval\-augmented generation and the requirement implications of grounding and source attribution.
* Familiarity with regulated or GxP\-adjacent documentation environments and their traceability expectations.
* Experience in a self\-directed vendor pod operating alongside, but independently of, a client’s internal build team.
* Formal certification in business analysis (CBAP/CCBA), agile delivery (CSPO, PSM) or project management (PMP).


**Compensation**
 Estimated Pay Range:
   

  

 Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.

title: Senior Manager – Moulding & Tool Maintenance
description:
**Position:** 
**Senior Manager – Moulding \& Tool Maintenance** 




**Department:** 
 Moulding
 



**Reporting to:** 
 Plant Head
 



**Location:** 
 Cochin, Kerala, India
 



**Position Summary:** 




 Provide strategic and operational leadership for a high\-technology, high\-volume Moulding operation supporting precision electronic connector manufacturing. Lead a manufacturing footprint of 50\+ injection moulding machines, covering vertical, horizontal, reel\-to\-reel, and over\-moulding technologies with advanced automation.
 



 Own the end\-to\-end performance of the Moulding function, including manufacturing operations, process engineering, automation, capacity planning, productivity, quality, cost, and delivery, while building and managing a robust external moulding ecosystem through vendor development, job work, and purchase models.
 



 Develop a high\-quality, technically capable, cost\-competitive, and scalable moulding vendor network to support business growth, capacity flexibility, localization, and supply continuity. Establish strong technical and commercial governance for outsourced moulding, ensuring consistent quality, competitive total cost, delivery reliability, process capability, and adherence to global manufacturing standards.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. High\-Tech Moulding Operations** 



* Lead a high\-volume Moulding shopfloor comprising 50\+ injection moulding machines, covering vertical, horizontal, reel\-to\-reel, and over\-moulding technologies.
* Drive performance across Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, OEE, Productivity, Yield, and Capacity Utilization.
* Optimize moulding processes, cycle times, machine utilization, material consumption, changeovers, and process stability.
* Drive advanced automation, robotics, vision systems, process monitoring, and digital manufacturing solutions.
* Establish robust manufacturing standards to ensure consistent and capable processes.



  





**2\. Moulding Vendor Development \& External Manufacturing** 



* Develop and maintain a strategic network of capable moulding vendors to support internal capacity and business growth.
* Identify, evaluate, technically assess, qualify, and develop new moulding vendors based on technology, capacity, quality systems, process capability, scalability, and cost competitiveness.
* Develop vendors capable of meeting stringent requirements for precision electronic connector components.
* Establish structured vendor capability assessment, qualification, process validation, and performance\-monitoring systems.
* Develop alternate sources and a resilient vendor base to mitigate capacity, quality, and supply risks.
* Drive continuous improvement of vendor capability through technical support, process audits, quality improvement initiatives, and performance reviews.



  





**3\. Job Work \& Purchase Model Management** 



* Develop and implement appropriate job\-work and purchase models based on product characteristics, capacity requirements, cost competitiveness, and strategic sourcing considerations.
* Evaluate the optimal make\-versus\-buy / internal\-versus\-external manufacturing approach for moulding requirements.
* Establish clear commercial, technical, quality, and delivery expectations for outsourced moulding.
* Drive cost\-effective external manufacturing without compromising product quality, process capability, IP protection, delivery, or customer requirements.
* Monitor and optimize the overall economics of outsourced moulding, including conversion cost, material utilization, logistics, tooling utilization, and total landed cost.
* Ensure effective capacity allocation between internal operations and external manufacturing partners.



  





**4\. Vendor Quality \& Process Capability** 



* Establish stringent quality and process capability requirements for all moulding vendors.
* Drive First\-Time\-Right, defect prevention, process capability, yield improvement, and reduction of customer\-related quality issues.
* Conduct regular supplier process audits and capability assessments.
* Ensure effective implementation of PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, MSA, process validation, and structured problem\-solving at key vendors.
* Lead supplier corrective and preventive actions for quality and delivery issues.
* Establish vendor scorecards covering Quality, Cost, Delivery, Capacity, Responsiveness, and Continuous Improvement.



  





**5\. Cost Competitiveness** 



* Drive a cost\-efficient moulding ecosystem through competitive sourcing, productivity improvement, process optimization, automation, and vendor development.
* Benchmark internal and external conversion costs and identify cost\-reduction opportunities.
* Develop competitive commercial models for job work and purchased moulded components.
* Partner with Procurement and Finance to ensure transparency and competitiveness of moulding costs.
* Drive annual cost\-reduction and productivity initiatives across the internal and external moulding network.



  





**6\. Capacity \& Business Continuity** 



* Develop short\-, medium\-, and long\-term moulding capacity strategies aligned with business growth and customer demand.
* Balance internal capacity with external vendor capacity to provide flexibility, scalability, and responsiveness.
* Establish contingency and alternate\-source strategies for critical components.
* Ensure vendor capacity readiness for new product launches, volume ramps, and demand fluctuations.



  





**7\. New Product Introduction \& Industrialization** 



* Partner with Engineering, NPI, Quality, and Supply Chain teams for successful industrialization of new moulded connector components.
* Assess manufacturability and external manufacturing feasibility during product development.
* Lead vendor selection, capability assessment, trials, validation, and production ramp\-up for outsourced moulding.
* Ensure new vendors and processes achieve required quality, capability, cost, and delivery targets before production release.



  





**8\. Operational Excellence \& Technology** 



* Drive Lean Manufacturing, TPM, Six Sigma, Kaizen, automation, and digital manufacturing across internal and external moulding operations.
* Benchmark advanced moulding technologies and global manufacturing practices.
* Promote data\-driven decision\-making and real\-time performance monitoring.
* Drive continuous improvement in OEE, yield, cycle time, scrap, energy consumption, and conversion cost.



  





**9\. People \& Leadership** 



* Lead and develop a high\-performing team across Moulding Operations, Process Engineering, and Moulding Vendor Development.
* Build strong technical capability in injection moulding, automation, process engineering, supplier development, and external manufacturing.
* Develop a culture of accountability, technical excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Build strong cross\-functional partnerships with Engineering, Quality, Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, and Global Operations.



  





**Qualification \& Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Polymer Engineering, or a related discipline from a reputed institution.
* A postgraduate qualification in Manufacturing, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field is an added advantage.
* 15\+ years of progressive experience in high\-volume injection moulding / plastics manufacturing, preferably within automotive, electronics, electrical, connector, or precision component manufacturing.
* Strong hands\-on and leadership experience in vertical, horizontal, reel\-to\-reel, and over\-moulding technologies, preferably with automated manufacturing systems.



  





**Key Success Measures** 



* Moulding OEE and capacity utilization
* Quality / PPM / First\-Pass Yield
* Internal and external moulding productivity
* Cycle\-time and scrap reduction
* Moulding conversion cost
* Vendor Quality and On\-Time Delivery
* Vendor capability and capacity readiness
* Vendor development / localization
* Job\-work and purchase\-model optimization
* Make\-versus\-buy effectiveness
* New product industrialization performance
* Cost\-reduction and productivity savings
* Automation and digitalization deployment
* Supply continuity and alternate\-source readiness

title: Engineering Head
description:
Difinity Digital is a Data and AI consulting firm delivering solutions across artificial intelligence, data and analytics, and digital engineering for clients in the UAE and Europe, alongside a portfolio of proprietary products.
 



 The Engineering Head holds complete ownership of the engineering function. The role carries accountability for technical strategy, delivery governance, engineering capability and organisational structure, in addition to the architecture and quality of every solution the company builds and deploys.
 



 The position combines functional leadership with continued technical depth. The Engineering Head is expected to set direction, build the team and govern delivery, while remaining sufficiently hands\-on in architecture and technical review to hold authority over engineering decisions.
 



  





**EXPERIENCE: 10\+ years** 




  





**2\. Key Responsibilities** 




**Engineering Strategy and Function Ownership** 



1. Define the technical strategy for the engineering function across AI, data and analytics, and product engineering.
2. Establish the technology roadmap, platform standards and architectural principles adopted across the organisation.
3. Build and maintain the engineering capability plan, including skill development, team structure and workforce planning.
4. Manage relationships with technology partners and platform vendors and evaluate new tooling and platforms for adoption.
5. Own engineering budgets, tooling investment and infrastructure cost governance.



  





**Delivery Governance** 



1. Hold accountability for technical delivery across all client engagements and internal product development.
2. Establish delivery methodology, engineering standards, quality gates and release governance.
3. Oversee resource allocation, utilisation and capacity planning across concurrent engagements.
4. Monitor delivery health, manage technical and schedule risk, and own resolution of technical escalations.
5. Report engineering performance, risk and capacity to the Director.



  





**Solution Architecture and Technical Requirements** 



1. Own solution architecture and data architecture standards across the organisation.
2. Approve the technical approach, feasibility position and effort estimation for new engagements.
3. Contribute directly to architecture design for complex, high\-risk or strategically significant engagements.
4. Review and approve the technical content of client proposals and statements of work.



  





**Technical Quality and Governance** 



1. Define and enforce code review, design review and security review standards.
2. Maintain final approval authority on architecture decisions and technical debt trade\-offs.
3. Drive the development of reusable frameworks, accelerators and reference implementations.



  





**Organisational and People Leadership** 



1. Lead, structure and scale the engineering organisation across all technical disciplines.
2. Own technical hiring, including role definition, assessment frameworks and interview panels.
3. Establish performance management, career progression paths and technical competency frameworks.
4. Mentor senior engineers and develop the next layer of technical leadership.



  





**Deployment, Security and Compliance** 



1. Ensure all solutions are deployed securely with appropriate access controls, data privacy measures and regulatory compliance.
2. Define governance for AI systems including model evaluation, guardrails, monitoring, failure handling and cost control.
3. Own production readiness criteria and post\-deployment support standards.



  





**Client and Commercial Engagement** 



1. Represent the engineering function in client engagements requiring senior technical authority, including solution workshops, architecture presentations and escalation management.
2. Support pre\-sales through technical validation, solution design and credibility in client\-facing technical discussions.



  





**3\. Skills and Experience** 




 Candidates are assessed on demonstrated capability and delivery track record rather than years of experience. Depth in every discipline is not expected.
 


1. Proven ownership of engineering delivery for a team or function, with accountability for architecture and quality outcomes.
2. Track record of taking production systems from requirement through to live deployment and ongoing support.
3. Strong, demonstrable expertise in at least one of the following areas: artificial intelligence, data and analytics, or product engineering.
4. Applied experience in artificial intelligence covering machine learning, computer vision or natural language processing, and generative AI including large language model applications and retrieval augmented generation.
5. Applied experience in data and analytics covering data engineering, pipeline design, warehouse or lakehouse architecture, data modelling, governance, and business intelligence.
6. Applied experience in product engineering covering application and product engineering, API and backend service design, enterprise system integration, cloud infrastructure and DevOps.
7. Sufficient working knowledge of the disciplines outside the primary area of expertise to conduct architecture review, validate estimates, assess technical risk and assess technical candidates.
8. Working knowledge of cloud deployment practice, CI/CD, security, access control and data privacy.
9. Understanding of AI governance including model evaluation, guardrails, monitoring and cost control.
10. Experience building, structuring and developing engineering teams.
11. Delivery experience in a consulting, professional services or client\-facing product environment.
12. Ability to present and defend technical positions to executive, client and engineering audiences.
13. Experience in offshore delivery models serving international clients is desirable.
14. Commercial understanding of utilisation, margin and estimation discipline in a services business is desirable.
15. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline. Postgraduate qualification desirable.

title: Patient Journey Partner- Neurology
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

**Patient Journey Partner\- Neurology**
**Location: All Locations**
**The Position**
 A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
   

  

 We are seeking candidates to join our team as Patient Journey Partner In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patient care by connecting Roche’s capabilities and resources to co\-create solutions with key stakeholders involved in the patient journey. title: Solar Project Manager
description:
We are expanding our residential rooftop solar operations across Kerala and need a practical, hands\-on Project Leader based in Kochi. Your main job is to take confirmed residential sales orders (mostly premium 3kW to 5kW residential systems) and get them installed, commissioned, and connected to the grid quickly without compromising on safety or structural quality.
 



  





 You will be actively managing our field supervisors, keeping external installation vendors in line, tracking local inventory, and dealing directly with KSEB to get net\-meters approved and commission solar projects. Prior experience managing residential rooftop solar projects is mandatory.
 



  





**What You Will Actually Do Day\-to\-Day** 
 :
 


* **End to End Project Execution** 
 : Oversee the day\-to\-day deployment of multiple residential rooftop solar projects simultaneously across key Kerala districts. Ensure all projects are completed on time, within budget, and to premium quality standards.
* **Team Leadership** 
 : Manage, mentor, and deploy a distributed team of site surveyors, field engineers, and installation supervisors. Establish strict safety protocols, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and quality checkpoints.
* **Vendor \& (I\&C) Management** 
 : Build, onboard, and manage a robust network of local Installation \& Commissioning (I\&C) teams and labor contractors. Negotiate rates, monitor daily progress, and audit their workmanship.
* **Procurement \& Inventory** 
 : Coordinate regional supply chain logistics. Manage structural, electrical, and component inventory (modules, inverters, structures, BoS) to ensure zero site\-delivery delays while minimizing local warehousing overheads.
* **DISCOM Liaisoning \& Subsidy paperwork** 
 : Own the relationship with KSEB officials to ensure seamless site inspections, structure approvals, and fast net\-metering synchronization. Ensure error\-free documentation for government subsidy claims.



  





**What We Are Looking For:** 



* **Education** 
 : B.Tech / Diploma in Electrical, Civil, or Mechanical Engineering.
* **Experience** 
 : 6 to 10\+ years in solar project management, with at least 2\+ years explicitly leading high\-volume residential or commercial rooftop solar installations.
* **Regulatory Knowledge** 
 : Deep familiarity with Kerala electrical safety regulations, DISCOM net\-metering procedures, and national portal subsidy guidelines.
* **Leadership Style** 
 : A hands\-on operational leader who split time between tracking timelines via project management tools and doing high\-audit site visits in the field.



**What’s in it for You:** 



* A fixed salary matching market standards.
* Performance bonuses tied directly to project turnaround time and zero\-defect quality audits.
* A direct line to the founders and the opportunity to scale our operational blueprint across the region.

title: Operations and Control Tower Lead
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an execution\-focused Operations \& Control Tower Lead to manage the operational engine behind our residential rooftop solar deployments.
 



  





 In this role, you will lead the central control desk that bridges sales, engineering, local utilities, banks, and the customer. You will be directly responsible for eliminating project bottlenecks—ensuring that every residential project clears financing, approvals, procurement, dispatch, and final grid synchronization without delays or paperwork friction.
 



  





 You will also manage a dedicated customer success and coordination team, ensuring homeowners experience proactive, transparent communication from the moment a contract is signed to final commissioning.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Central Order\-to\-Delivery Ownership** 
 : Run the central operations desk tracking residential projects from contract signing through to final commissioning and handoff.
* **Customer Success Desk Management** 
 : Lead and coach a team of customer coordinators/relationship executives. Set clear service\-level agreements (SLAs), communication cadences, and escalation protocols so customers are continuously updated via WhatsApp, calls, and email.
* **Financing \& Banking Coordination** 
 : Work directly with partner banks and NBFCs to track customer solar loan applications, push fast document verification, and secure timely disbursements.
* **Utility \& Regulatory Approvals** 
 : Drive all documentation and registration workflows with local electricity boards (such as KSEB) for initial feasibility approvals, net\-metering allocations, and final site inspections.
* **Government Portal \& Subsidy Management** 
 : Oversee end\-to\-end documentation, portal applications, and compliance filings for central/state solar subsidy programs to achieve zero document rejection rates.
* **Supply Chain \& Field Alignment** 
 : Act as the operational bridge between field sales teams, project engineers, and central inventory. Authorize site dispatch triggers only after ensuring full commercial and documentation clearance.
* **Data \& SLA Tracking** 
 : Maintain absolute data integrity across CRM and operations dashboards. Track and optimize operational metrics, including time\-to\-dispatch, utility approval cycle times, and overall project turnaround times (TAT).
* **Metrics you will own** 
 : Revenue, TAT for financial closure, Outstanding collections
* **Metrics you will be tracking** 
 and influencing the org: Dispatch \& Installation TAT, Overall project TAT, Customer NPS



**What We Are Looking For** 



* **Experience** 
 : 10\+ years of hands\-on operations experience in roles such as Project Operations Lead, Order\-to\-Delivery Manager, Operations Control Tower, or Post\-Sales Operations Lead.
* **High bias for action** 
 : Ability to arrive at the next step, given conflicting constraints around the situation, most of the project situations need quick reaction.
* **Domain Familiarity** 
 : Prior experience in residential rooftop solar, retail banking operations (home/consumer loan processing), telecom/broadband network deployments, or high\-value residential installations.
* **Team Leadership** 
 : At least 4\+ years managing a customer support, back\-office operations, or project tracking team.
* **Process Fluency:** 
 Practical working knowledge in complex processes, typically involving multiple external agencies/portals. Ability to assess process flows and make changes. Ability to root\-cause situations that arise in day to day project flows.
* **Problem Solver** 
 : Highly organized individual with strong troubleshooting abilities who can unblock administrative hold\-ups and maintain strict accountability across teams.
* **Languages** 
 : Fluency in Malayalam and English is mandatory to effectively manage local coordination and cross\-functional operations.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Competitive fixed compensation structure.
* Performance bonuses linked to operational velocity, turnaround times, and customer satisfaction metrics.
* A high\-impact role driving the core operational backbone of a fast\-growing residential clean\-tech business.

 Learning consulting with deployable organisational change management capability

 India\-based with willingness for short\- or long\-term deployment across KSA, UAE and Qatar
   

  

**THE OPPORTUNITY**
 The Senior Consultant is a founding delivery and pursuit hire for the growing MENA Learning \& Change capability. The role translates complex client and RFP requirements into practical learning, adoption and capability\-building solutions, then owns key workstreams through delivery.
   

  

 The successful candidate will combine Learning \& Development consulting, organisational change management, proposal development, facilitation and responsible AI usage. The role supports MENA priorities, with KSA as the primary growth market and government, energy and financial services as sector priorities. One of the two Senior Consultant vacancies will require demonstrated business\-level Arabic proficiency.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Client delivery and workstream ownership**
* Own one or more learning and change workstreams across scope, quality, schedule, effort, dependencies, risks and client communication.
* Lead discovery interviews, focus groups, learning needs analyses, skills\-gap assessments, stakeholder workshops and design sessions.
* Translate business outcomes into capability frameworks, curriculum architectures, blended learning journeys, facilitator\-led experiences and measurement plans.
* Produce and quality\-review client\-ready strategies, roadmaps, workshop packs, recommendations, dashboards and implementation plans.
* Facilitate stakeholder and learner sessions and present workstream recommendations to client managers and senior stakeholders.
* Coach Staff Consultants and coordinate specialists, designers, facilitators and technology contributors across the workstream.


**Learning transformation and change management**
* Design integrated learning and adoption approaches covering audience analysis, impacts, readiness, stakeholder engagement, communications, training, reinforcement and sustainment.
* Apply instructional design methods such as ADDIE or SAM to learning journeys, curricula, academies, leadership programmes and capability\-building interventions.
* Develop learning operating model, managed learning services, governance, intake, content operations and performance\-measurement components where relevant.
* Support leadership assessment\-led development assignments, including administration and interpretation when appropriately accredited, and convert insights into development pathways.
* Use evaluation and analytics approaches to measure participation, learning transfer, adoption and business impact.


**Pursuits, proposals and business development**
* Independently draft solution approaches, proposal narratives, methodologies, workplans, staffing models, delivery plans, assumptions, risks and effort estimates.
* Analyse RFP requirements, develop compliance matrices and help create differentiated win themes and client\-specific solution stories under tight turnaround times.
* Create proposal slides, capability showcases, credentials, case studies, benchmarks and sector research for MENA partner and account teams.
* Participate in partner reviews, solution workshops and oral presentation preparation; present assigned sections confidently when required.
* Identify follow\-on opportunities during delivery and shape them into a clear problem statement, proposed response and indicative scope.


**AI\-enabled learning and technology**
* Use Microsoft Copilot and other approved generative AI tools for research, synthesis, proposal development, learning design and content acceleration in line with firm policies.
* Design AI\-enabled learning use cases, with particular emphasis on a learning content generation accelerator, personalised journeys and analytics\-assisted decisions.
* Apply human review, factual verification, accessibility, privacy, confidentiality, intellectual property and quality controls to AI\-assisted output.
* Bring working knowledge of LXP, AI learning platforms, talent marketplaces, LMS ecosystems and learning analytics to solution design.
* Guide Staff Consultants in effective prompt design, AI\-assisted production and responsible review practices.


**Capability building and internal contribution**
* Build and maintain reusable proposal content, credentials, case studies, research, methods, templates and delivery assets.
* Convert project learning into portfolio intellectual property and support capability demonstrations and internal roadshows.
* Contribute to recruitment assessments, onboarding, coaching, certification pathways and community\-of\-practice activity.
* Balance client delivery with pursuit and capability commitments in a lean, growth\-stage team.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Consulting judgement: structures ambiguous problems, forms hypotheses, makes evidence\-based recommendations and knows when to escalate.
* Dual capability: can lead both a learning design conversation and a change/adoption conversation without treating them as separate disciplines.
* Proposal craft: writes clear, persuasive and executable solutions rather than generic capability statements.
* Facilitation and design thinking: designs productive workshops and moves diverse stakeholders towards decisions.
* Client communication: produces director\-ready documents and communicates confidently in virtual and in\-person settings.
* AI fluency: uses AI to increase speed and quality while retaining human accountability and professional scepticism.
* Builder mindset: creates reusable capability while meeting immediate delivery requirements.


**Essential**
**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE**
* 7–9 years of relevant experience across L\&D consulting, learning transformation and organisational change management.
* Demonstrated client\-facing consulting experience and independent ownership of learning or change workstreams.
* Evidence of contribution to RFPs, solution approaches, proposal writing, effort estimation and presentation development.
* Depth in learning strategy, needs analysis, curriculum and journey design, facilitation, evaluation and capability building.
* Practical experience in change impacts, stakeholder engagement, communications, readiness, adoption and reinforcement.
* Hands\-on use of generative AI and Microsoft Copilot for consulting, proposals or learning work.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, HR, education, organisational development, psychology or a related discipline.


**Preferred**
* GCC or MENA delivery or proposal experience, especially in government, energy or financial services.
* Big Four or global consulting experience.
* Experience in managed learning services, learning operating models, leadership development or leadership assessment\-led development.
* Exposure to LXP, AI learning platforms, talent marketplaces and learning analytics.
* Experience with SuccessFactors Learning, Cornerstone, Workday Learning, Degreed, EdCast or similar platforms.
* Working knowledge of Articulate Storyline, Rise, Vyond, Camtasia, Captivate or comparable content tools.
* Experience on digital transformation, ERP, AI adoption or workforce transformation programmes


**ARABIC LANGUAGE REQUIREMENT**
**For the Arabic\-designated Senior Consultant vacancy:** 
 business\-level Arabic in reading, writing and speaking is mandatory. The candidate must be able to review proposal content, participate in client discussions, support workshops and interpret business context accurately. Native nationality or ethnic origin is not a requirement.
   

  

* Assessment should include a role\-relevant Arabic writing exercise, proposal review, a short client conversation and workshop facilitation simulation.
* Language capability should be evaluated consistently against job\-relevant performance, not nationality or background.


**CERTIFICATIONS**
**Required At Joining Or Within Agreed Development Plan**
* PROSCI or an equivalent recognised change management certification.
* Design thinking / human\-centred design / workshop facilitation credential or demonstrable equivalent experience.
* Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI or comparable applied AI credential.
* One recognised learning credential or structured pathway towards APTD, CPTD or equivalent

* Kirkpatrick learning evaluation credential.
* Hogan, SHL or Korn Ferry practitioner accreditation.
* Agile, Scrum or SAFe certification.
* Learning analytics, LMS, LXP or talent\-platform certification.
* Recognised business Arabic proficiency evidence, supplemented by practical assessment.

* 50% client delivery.
