title: Learning and Change Transformation - Staff
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS \| PEOPLE CONSULTING \| LEARNING \& CHANGE**
 Staff Consultant, Learning \& Change
   

  

 Build consulting craft. Create with AI. Connect across languages.
   

  

**ROLE SNAPSHOT**
**Role**
 Staff Consultant, Learning \& Change
   

  

**Portfolio**
 Learning \& Development, People Consulting MENA
   

  

**Experience**
 2–4 years of relevant professional experience
   

  

**Capability model**
 Learning consulting with organisational change capability and AI\-enabled ways of working
   

  

**THE OPPORTUNITY**
 This role is an entry point into a consulting career in Learning and Change within EY GDS People Consulting. You will contribute to live MENA client work, strategic proposals and capability\-building initiatives across government, energy and financial services, with KSA as the primary growth market.
   

  

 You will own defined pieces of work, such as a storyboard, learning asset, stakeholder map, research pack, proposal section, workshop pack, readiness tracker or dashboard. The role blends learning design, change enablement, digital learning, project coordination and responsible use of AI. It is not a learning administration\-only position.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Learning design and capability development**
* Support learning needs analysis, learner personas, skills\-gap reviews and role\-to\-capability mapping
* Help design learning journeys, curriculum maps, course outlines and blended learning experiences across ILT, VILT, WBT, microlearning and performance support.
* Develop e\-learning modules, storyboards, facilitator and learner guides, job aids, simulations, quick\-reference guides, assessments and reinforcement assets.
* Use adult learning principles and instructional design methods such as ADDIE or SAM, under guidance from senior team members.
* Support learning evaluation, feedback analysis, knowledge assessment and outcome reporting.


**Organisational change and adoption support**
* Maintain stakeholder registers, change\-impact logs, readiness trackers and adoption dashboards.
* Support stakeholder analysis, focus groups, surveys and workshop output synthesis.
* Draft change communications, campaign content, FAQs, toolkits and champion\-network materials for review.
* Assist with readiness, adoption and reinforcement activities that connect learning to business change outcomes.


**Pursuits, proposals and market support**
* Conduct structured client, sector, benchmark and competitor research for RFPs, RFQs and proactive proposals.
* Draft proposal content, credentials, CVs, case studies, methodology slides, workplan inputs and capability\-showcase materials.
* Create clear, consulting\-quality PowerPoint materials and maintain version control under tight deadlines.
* Review source material, support proposal content and participate in stakeholder discussions.
* Help maintain the capability, proposal and case\-study repositories.


**Client delivery, facilitation and learning operations**
* Own defined deliverables and project tasks, track dependencies and raise risks early.
* Prepare workshop materials, digital collaboration boards, logistics, attendance and feedback instruments; capture and structure outputs.
* Facilitate selected portions of learning sessions, focus groups and working meetings under appropriate supervision.
* Support learning intake, schedules, deployment, LMS or LXP content setup, testing, reporting and post\-course sustainment where included in project scope.
* Build collaborative working relationships with client contacts, subject\-matter experts and internal teams.


**AI\-enabled learning and digital content**
* Use Microsoft Copilot and other approved generative AI tools for research, synthesis, proposal support, storyboarding, assessment generation and content development.
* Apply human review, fact\-checking, privacy, copyright, accessibility and quality controls to all AI\-assisted outputs.
* Contribute to AI\-enabled learning use cases, including learning content generation, microlearning, personalised pathways and analytics support.
* Create or edit digital learning assets using tools such as Articulate Storyline and Rise, Captivate, Vyond, Camtasia, Synthesia, Clipchamp or comparable platforms.
* Support content upload, testing and reporting on platforms such as SuccessFactors Learning, Cornerstone, Workday Learning, Degreed, Docebo, SharePoint or similar environments.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Consulting potential: Structures information clearly, asks good questions and connects deliverables to the client need.
* Written and visual communication: Produces concise English and well\-structured presentations with strong attention to detail.
* AI fluency: Uses AI productively and responsibly rather than treating generated output as final.
* Design sensibility: Understands learning experience, usability, visual hierarchy and audience needs.
* Ownership and coachability: Closes assigned work, raises risks early and applies feedback quickly.
* Organisation: Manages several tasks, deadlines and versions without losing quality.


**Qualifications And Experience**
**Essentia**
* 1–3 years of relevant experience in learning design, L\&D, content development, training delivery, change support, HR or organisational development, consulting or a related area.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, human resources, education, psychology, organisational development, communication, design or a related discipline.
* Working knowledge of adult learning principles and instructional design; exposure to ADDIE, SAM or comparable methods.
* Experience creating professional presentations, learning content, communications or structured business documents.
* Strong Microsoft PowerPoint, Word and Excel capability; familiarity with digital collaboration tools.
* Practical use of Microsoft Copilot or comparable generative AI tools for research, synthesis or content creation, with evidence of responsible review.
* Demonstrated business\-level proficiency to review proposal content, take part in stakeholder discussions and support workshops.
* Excellent spoken and written English and willingness to support MENA working hours.


**Preferred**
* Experience in a consulting, professional\-services, GCC\-facing or shared\-services environment.
* Exposure to organisational change frameworks.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one digital learning authoring or media tool.
* Exposure to LMS, LXP, digital adoption platforms, learning analytics or Power BI.
* Experience supporting proposals, market research, credentials or business\-development materials.
* Exposure to government, energy or financial\-services contexts.


**CERTIFICATIONS AND DEVELOPMENT**
 Required at joining or within the agreed development plan Preferred / differentiating
   

  

* Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI or comparable applied AI fundamentals
* Design thinking / human\-centred design foundation
* Instructional design or adult learning foundation
* Change management foundation or agreed pathway
* PROSCI foundation or equivalent
* APTD or similar learning credential
* Agile fundamentals
* Articulate, learning platform or learning analytics credential


**WAYS OF WORKING**
 Initial ramp\-up: approximately 50% client delivery, 30% pursuits and proposals, 10% capability building and 10% internal initiatives, subject to demand and staffing.
   

  

 Once deployed to a billable engagement: approximately 70% client delivery and 30% pursuits, proposal support and capability building, subject to engagement commitments and portfolio priorities.
   

  

**KEY SUCCESS MEASURES: FIRST 12 MONTHS**
**Dimension**
**Delivery**
 Support at least one significant learning or change workstream; deliver assigned outputs at first or second review with limited rework. Workplan, review records and engagement feedback.
   

  

**Pursuits**
 Support at least 5 strategic pursuits and contribute substantive content to at least 3 proposal submissions, subject to pipeline volume. Pursuit tracker and proposal records.
   

  

**AI adoption**
 Demonstrate responsible AI\-assisted working in research, proposals or content; contribute to one AI\-enabled learning use case or accelerator. Approved work samples, demo or use\-case record.
   

  

**Capability assets**
 Create or materially improve at least 2 reusable assets, templates, credentials or case studies. Repository and reuse log.
   

  

**Digital learning**
 Demonstrate working competence in at least one authoring or media tool and exposure to one learning platform or analytics tool. Skills assessment or project evidence.
   

  

**Growth**
 Complete agreed learning, change and AI development milestones and show progress toward Consultant readiness. Development plan and certification record.
   

  

**Utilisation**
 Meet the approved grade utilisation target and agreed delivery/BD allocation, with targets calibrated to actual staffing. Utilisation and resource reports.
   

  

**What Ey Offers**
* Exposure to live MENA learning, change, digital adoption and workforce capability programmes.
* A structured pathway across learning consulting, organisational change, AI\-enabled learning and consulting craft.
* Hands\-on experience with modern authoring tools, learning platforms, analytics and approved AI tools.
* Coaching from experienced consultants and the opportunity to shape a growing portfolio.
* A career path from Staff Consultant to broader workstream and solution ownership.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: MEP DESIGN COORDINATOR
description:
**Company Description** 




  





 Creo Homes Pvt Ltd is a leading architectural design and turnkey construction company based in Kochi, Kerala, specializing in luxury homes that blend creativity, quality, and ethics. The company brings together architects, engineers, interior designers, and skilled craftsmen to deliver personalized living spaces that reflect each client’s aspirations. Covering architecture, construction, interiors, and landscaping under one roof, Creo Homes offers a seamless, end\-to\-end project experience. Every project is guided by responsibility, respect, and a strong focus on customer satisfaction, ensuring excellence in every detail. With a vision to become one of India’s most trusted home design brands, the company aims to expand to 20 cities by 2035 through innovation, robust systems, and a client\-first culture.
 



  





**Role Description** 



* The MEP Design Coordinator is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Ernakulam, responsible for coordinating Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing design across residential projects.
* This role involves reviewing and integrating MEP drawings with architectural and structural designs, ensuring technical accuracy and compliance with relevant codes and standards.
* The coordinator will manage design submittals, track approvals, and collaborate closely with architects, engineers, contractors, and vendors to resolve design clashes and execution issues.
* Day\-to\-day tasks include preparing and updating design documentation, supporting project planning and scheduling, attending site coordination meetings, and providing technical guidance to site teams.
* The position also requires monitoring design changes, maintaining clear communication among stakeholders, and contributing to quality, safety, and cost\-effective design solutions.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Diploma / B.Tech / B.E. in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil or related engineering field.
* 2–5 years of relevant experience in MEP coordination or construction projects.
* Experience in residential / villa / turnkey projects will be an advantage.
* Good knowledge of electrical and plumbing systems.
* Basic knowledge of HVAC and other building services.
* Proficiency in
 **AutoCAD** 
 is required.

title: ADTL/DTL
description:
Job Overview
   

 Manage end\-to\-end delivery of data management services for single/multi\-service projects with minimal guidance, ensuring quality deliverables on time and within budget, to customer satisfaction. Provide comprehensive data management expertise to Data Management (DM) team to provide high quality data management products that meet customer needs. Provide leadership to the team in the areas of project planning, execution, and close\-out; Overview of financial management for data management activities; communications; and milestone deliverables. Perform role of Data Team Lead (DTL). 
 



 Essential Functions
   

 • Gather Study Set up requirements through discussion and communication with relevant stakeholders.
   

 • With Minimal guidance \- support, overview of validation of new Device integrations.
   

 • Oversight \& Perform regular Data cleaning activities to ensure clean data with quality and timely deliverables to sponsor.
   

 • Ensure that all the deliverables are of expected quality standards and meet customer expectations.
   

 • With guidance, ensure service and quality meet agreed upon timelines and deliverables in contract/Scope of Work (SOW).
   

 • Support Training of New joiners.
   

 • Lead internal study meetings and internal/ sponsor audits and participate in Study Kick off meetings and other sponsor meetings.
   

 • Tracks and manages the projects, oversee project progress, identify risks and take corrective action to rectify any errors as recommended as required.
   

 • With Guidance manage \& oversight the implementation of new technology / database revisions.
   

 • Work closely with the programming team for process innovation and automation.
   

 • Be compliant to trainings and eSOP reading.
   

 • Provide review and expert opinion in developing, revising, and maintaining core operating procedures and working instructions.
   

 • Communication with Line Manager, and other team members across functions should be collaborative.
   

 • Perform other duties as directed by Line Manager.
 



 Qualifications
   

 • Bachelor's Degree In health, clinical, biological or mathematical sciences, or related field with proven experience in Data Management Req
   

 • 3 \-4 years direct Data Management experience, including a minimum of 1 year as a CDM project lead. Pref
   

 • English Fluency Spoken and English Advanced
   

 • Advanced computer applications like Microsoft excel, word, Inbox etc Advanced
   

 • Should have Advanced understanding of Drug development lifecycle and Overall Clinical research process Advanced
 







 IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com
 







 IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

title: SAP TRM - Manager
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Service line \- Position Title: Consulting \- SAP TRM Manager**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 EY Consulting is a fast\-moving, high\-growth area with huge potential. We are currently recruiting for a Seniors to join our team. This team offers variety, challenge, responsibility and the opportunity to realize your leadership potential. Being a member of our Consulting team means you will specialize in a particular competency \- Risk, Technology Consulting, or IT Risk \& Assurance. Our Technology Consulting team is focused on helping clients improve operational efficiency and security, while also reducing costs and managing risk.
   

  

 In this role, we are looking for an experienced SAP TRM Manager to join our growing SAP Finance team. As an SAP Treasury and Risk Management (TRM) Manager you will oversee the design, implementation, and optimization of SAP S/4HANA treasury solutions, focusing on cash management, transaction management, and risk analysis. They lead teams, manage stakeholder relationships, map business processes, and ensure regulatory compliance for treasury operations.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Conduct Business Blueprint design workshops to gather requirements and understand the client's business processes.
* Lead end\-to\-end SAP TRM implementations, including Blueprinting, Configuration, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
* Optimize cash management, liquidity planning, bank communication, and hedge accounting.
* Utilize Market Risk Analyzer and Credit Risk Analyzer to mitigate financial risks.
* Prepare functional gaps analysis by identifying areas where standard SAP S4 HANA TRM functionalities need enhancements or customization

title: Project Coordinator
description:
**Company Description** 
 Riafy Technologies partners with leading global brands to think, ideate, build, and grow digital products that create meaningful impact. Its consumer apps are used by over 100 million people in 160 countries and 23 languages, and trusted by partners such as Google, Apple, Siemens, Sony, major banks, airlines, and FMCG leaders. Riafy fosters a culture of belonging, inclusion, and diversity, has tripled in size in recent years, and was honored with the Google Partner Award 2023 for DEI in APAC.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Project Coordinator role at Riafy Technologies is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Kochi. This role involves coordinating project activities, tracking timelines and deliverables, and ensuring clear communication among cross\-functional teams such as product, engineering, design, and client stakeholders. The Project Coordinator will assist in preparing project plans, status reports, and documentation, and will help identify risks and dependencies to keep initiatives on schedule and within scope. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include organizing meetings, maintaining task lists and project dashboards, supporting resource allocation, and following up on action items. The role also includes contributing to process improvements, supporting quality assurance efforts, and helping ensure that projects align with partner expectations and Riafy’s standards for innovation and impact.

* Strong project coordination and organizational skills, including experience with scheduling, task tracking, and maintaining project documentation.

* Comfort working in fast\-paced, cross\-functional environments; ability to prioritize and manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.

* Experience in tech, SaaS, AI, or digital product companies is an advantage, especially exposure to enterprise solutions or global clients.
* Commitment to inclusive, collaborative teamwork and openness to learning new tools, processes, and technologies.

title: Technical Test Lead 3
description:
**Job Title: Technical Test Lead \- Specialist \- ACS Song**
**Management Level: Level 9 \- Specialist**
**Location: Kochi**
**Must Have Skills: Web \& API Automation, Java and/or JavaScript/TypeScript**
**Good to have skills: CI/CD (Azure DevOps / GitLab CI / Jenkins), AI\-assisted testing tools**
**Experience: 5\-8 years of experience is required**
**Educational Qualification: Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)**
**Job Summary**
 At Accenture Song, delivering high\-quality software solutions is a core value. As a Technical Test Lead, you will be responsible for overseeing end\-to\-end testing strategies, driving test automation initiatives, and mentoring the QA team. Your leadership will help ensure quality standards across all aspects of the SDLC—from planning to delivery. You will work closely with development, DevOps, and business teams to align QA efforts with overall project goals.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Define and own the overall automation testing strategy, ensuring alignment with project and product goals.
* Identify areas suitable for automation, perform ROI analysis, and prioritize test cases for automation.
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reusable automation frameworks for both UI and API testing using industry best practices (e.g., Hybrid, BDD, POM).
* Lead the creation of comprehensive automation test plans outlining objectives, scope, tools, timelines, risks, and mitigation strategies aligned with business goals.
* Develop, execute, and maintain automated test suites for web applications, REST APIs, and backend services.
* Review automation code, test scripts, and execution results to ensure quality, maintainability, and adherence to automation standards and best practices.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Developers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into effective test scenarios and automation solutions.
* Integrate automation suites into CI/CD pipelines and ensure reliable execution as part of the continuous delivery process.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve automation framework, environment, configuration, and test data issues to improve execution stability and reliability.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to QA engineers by establishing automation standards, coding practices, and testing best practices.
* Monitor automation coverage, execution trends, defect metrics, and overall quality KPIs, providing regular status updates to stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvement in testing processes, automation frameworks, tooling, and overall quality engineering practices.
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand\-ups, and retrospectives as part of Agile teams.
* Evaluate and recommend new testing tools, frameworks, AI\-assisted solutions, and engineering practices to continuously enhance the QA automation capability.
* Leverage AI\-assisted tools and workflows to improve requirement analysis, test design, automation development, defect analysis, and overall QA productivity.

 Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager Testing with 15 years of experience in Software Testing, Test Automation, and Quality Assurance Engineering. The ideal candidate will be responsible for shaping QA and automation strategies, leading testing teams, supporting RFP responses, presales and solutioning initiatives, and driving the adoption of modern quality engineering practices, including CI/CD, Continuous Testing, and AI\-enabled testing. This role requires a strong blend of technical leadership, testing practice management, solutioning expertise, and client engagement experience to drive quality transformation across complex technology programs. Experience in Digital Commerce, Retail, or other large\-scale customer\-facing platforms is highly desirable.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Define and lead enterprise and programme\-level Quality Assurance strategies aligned with business objectives, technology architecture, delivery models, and risk. Assess existing testing practices and establish QA transformation roadmaps, target operating models, governance frameworks, engineering standards, and measurable quality outcomes.
* Design scalable, maintainable, and fit\-for\-purpose test automation architectures covering UI, API, integration, component, contract, and end\-to\-end testing. Define automation frameworks, reusable components, test\-data strategies, reporting, environment requirements, maintenance approaches, and technology selection based on application architecture, project requirements, scalability, maintainability, and overall QA strategy.
* Define and implement CI/CD\-integrated Quality Assurance and continuous testing strategies that provide fast, reliable, and actionable feedback throughout the software delivery lifecycle. Establish appropriate test execution strategies across pull requests, builds, deployments, integration and staging environments, regression cycles, and production validation.
* Address and optimise the practical engineering challenges associated with continuous testing, including pipeline efficiency, test reliability, execution time, environment readiness, test\-data management, dependencies, parallelisation, selective test execution, quality gates, and pipeline stability. Establish practices such as test impact analysis, risk\-based test selection, mocking, tagging, and other optimisation techniques to improve feedback time and pipeline reliability.
* Define and monitor QA and CI/CD metrics including automation coverage, execution time, test reliability, flakiness, pipeline stability, defect leakage, release confidence, and other relevant engineering and business outcomes.
* Define and lead Performance Testing strategies for critical applications, services, and customer journeys, covering workload modelling, test planning, scripting, execution, scalability, capacity assessment, performance monitoring, bottleneck identification, detailed test\-result analysis, performance optimisation, and performance regression.
* Lead detailed analysis of Performance Test results by correlating application, infrastructure, and monitoring metrics to identify performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints, resource utilisation issues, and system\-level degradation. Translate findings into actionable recommendations for performance optimisation, scalability, capacity planning, and engineering improvements.
* Define and implement API, Contract, and Component Testing strategies, establishing the appropriate balance across component, contract, API, integration, UI, end\-to\-end, and performance testing based on application architecture, business risk, and delivery requirements.
* Define test planning and test case design approaches across programmes, ensuring appropriate test scope, scenarios, coverage, traceability, risk\-based prioritisation, test data, environment requirements, entry/exit criteria, and execution strategies aligned with business and technical requirements.
* Partner with Development, DevOps, Architecture, Product, and Platform Engineering teams within and outside the organisation to embed quality throughout the software development and delivery lifecycle and promote shift\-left, continuous testing, and engineering\-led quality practices.
* Lead or significantly contribute to RFP, RFI, RFQ, presales, and client solutioning engagements from a Quality Assurance perspective. Translate client requirements and technology challenges into differentiated QA solutions, including QA strategies, automation architectures, CI/CD and continuous testing approaches, performance strategies, implementation roadmaps, effort estimates, resource models, timelines, assumptions, dependencies, risks, delivery approaches, and expected outcomes. Participate in client discovery sessions, solution workshops, proposal discussions, technical presentations, and solution defence activities.
* Drive the adoption of AI, GenAI, Agentic, and MCP\-based testing across Quality Assurance, identifying and implementing high\-value use cases such as test generation, automation code generation, test maintenance, test\-data generation, failure and defect analysis, intelligent test selection, test optimisation, and test\-result analysis. Lead the evaluation and adoption of AI\-enabled solutions capable of planning, generating, executing, analysing, and adapting testing activities.
* Mentor and develop QA professionals across technical testing, test automation, performance testing, modern testing practices, solutioning, proposals, RFP/RFI/RFQ engagements, and client\-facing activities. Provide technical guidance, knowledge sharing, coaching, and career development support while building strong testing capabilities and technical leadership within the team.
* Act as a trusted Quality Assurance advisor to senior stakeholders and clients, providing technical direction, influencing technology and delivery decisions, communicating risks and recommendations, and aligning QA outcomes with broader business objectives.

title: PMO Lead – Business Transformation
description:
**Job Description: PMO Lead – Business Transformation**




*Full\-time \| Kochi, Kerala* 




**Role Overview** 




  





**Symega is undertaking a company\-wide business transformation program, guided by a leading global strategy firm's blueprint to significantly scale the business over the next five years. To drive execution, we are hiring a full\-time PMO Lead to be the connective tissue between the transformation strategy and day\-to\-day delivery across the organization.** 




**This is not a reporting or coordination\-only role. The PMO Lead will work closely with business unit heads, operations, supply chain, and finance teams to understand the real complexity behind transformation initiatives, identify blockers, and actively contribute to solving them — while keeping the program on track against timelines and milestones.** 




**Reporting Structure** 




**Primary reporting line:** 
 External Transformation Office Lead (engaged consultant, on\-site 3–4 days/month, daily availability via email/calls)
 



**Dotted line:** 
 Director responsible for the Transformation program
 



 This structure ensures the PMO Lead is guided by proven transformation expertise while staying closely connected to the operating rhythm of the business.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**•        Own end\-to\-end tracking of timelines, milestones, and deliverables across all transformation workstreams.** 




**•        Act as the primary link between the external transformation office and internal business teams, ensuring alignment and momentum between strategy sessions.** 




**•        Proactively identify risks and blockers across workstreams and escalate with clear context and recommended options.** 




**•        Run regular stakeholder syncs with business unit heads, operations, supply chain, and finance leaders.** 




**•        Prepare status reports and dashboards for leadership, translating progress into clear, decision\-ready updates.** 




**•        Engage directly with the operational complexity of initiatives — supply chain alignment, capacity expansion, and similar decisions — to genuinely understand issues rather than simply report on them.** 




**•        Partner with business teams on problem\-solving for specific transformation initiatives, contributing analysis and options, not just tracking status.** 
























**Candidate Profile** 




**•        4–6 years of experience, with meaningful exposure to PMO or transformation office roles within a manufacturing organization.** 




**•        MBA from a top\-tier institute, or a well\-regarded Indian institute (e.g., XLRI, XIMB).** 




**•        Strong understanding of how manufacturing businesses operate — candidates from pure services backgrounds are not the fit for this role.** 




**•        Prior experience at the PMO Manager / Senior Manager level, having led a workstream or small team, with the credibility to engage senior stakeholders.** 




**•        Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving skills, with comfort operating in ambiguity.** 




**•        Excellent communication skills — able to synthesize complexity for leadership and hold their own in operational discussions.** 




**Tenure \& Growth Path** 




**This role is structured as a 2–3 year engagement tied to the transformation program, giving the incoming candidate a clear mandate and defined purpose. Strong performers who deliver results during this period will be considered for leadership roles within the businesses that emerge from the transformation — offering a genuine path beyond the program itself.** 




**Location** 




**Kochi, Kerala — based full\-time at Symega, with travel as required across manufacturing sites.**

description:
**Job Title: Senior SAP HCM Consultant** 




**Experience: 5\+ Years** 




**Location: Remote** 




  





 We are Looking for an experienced
 **Senior SAP HCM Consultant with expertise in Personnel Administration, Payroll, Time Management, Organizational Management, and Indian Payroll statutory compliance** 
 . The role involves end\-to\-end
 **SAP HCM configuration, client interactions, UAT support, S/4HANA migration, and mentoring junior consultants.** 




  





**Responsibilities** 



* Lead design and configuration of HR master data structures — Personnel Areas, Subareas, Employee Groups/Subgroups, and organizational assignments.
* Configure Info types across the employee lifecycle (hiring, transfers, promotions, separations, rehires) and design Personnel Actions and Dynamic Actions.
* Configure enterprise/HR organizational structure and integrate PA with Organisational Management (position management, reporting structure, vacancy management).
* Manage HR data security, including authorization profiles and structural authorisations for sensitive data access.
* Design and configure end\-to\-end payroll processes — schema, PCRs (Personnel Calculation Rules), wage type catalogues, and payroll cycle management.
* Implement statutory compliance for Indian payroll (PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Income Tax/TDS, Gratuity, Labour Welfare Fund) and manage off\-cycle and retroactive payroll runs.
* Configure Bank Transfer (DME) processes and integrate payroll with FI/CO (symbolic accounts, posting documents, reconciliation); troubleshoot payroll errors and schema issues.
* Design and configure Time Management — work schedules, holiday calendars, absence/attendance types, counting rules, and quota generation.
* Set up Time Evaluation (schema TM00/TM04\), configure positive/negative time recording, and implement CATS for project\-based time recording.
* Lead requirements workshops and blueprint sessions; produce functional design specs, configuration workbooks, test scripts, and training materials.
* Manage workstreams through go\-live and hypercare , support UAT and cutover activities, and mentor junior HCM consultants.



**Qualifications** 



* 5\+ years of SAP HCM functional experience across at least 2 full\-cycle implementations or major rollout projects.
* Full mastery of enterprise and personnel structure (Personnel Area, Subarea, Employee Group/Subgroup, Pay Scale) and comprehensive Infotype knowledge.
* Experience configuring Personnel Actions, Dynamic Actions, and HR workflows, along with structural and role\-based authorisations.
* Integration experience with Organisational Management (OM) and ESS/MSS portals.
* Minimum 3 years of hands\-on SAP Payroll configuration, including schema and PCR development (reading, writing, and debugging).

 We are looking for a colleague to join our virtual team working from over 20 geographical locations across the world. We offer flexible working, the chance to work in a multicultural and multinational environment, and best in class teaming and collaboration.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 This role in the global learning team that will give you the opportunity to make a difference by helping EY professionals globally grow their skills and accelerate their careers.
   

  

 This position is responsible for project management of design, development and curation of individual learning items and blended learning programs. The project manager will monitor the progress of instructional designers, developers, graphic artists, quality assurance specialists and all others associated with the design process. They will assist portfolio design leads and managers in overseeing and managing all design activities necessary to deliver learning products that meet EY’s design quality standards, on time and to budget. The project manager will also work to a set of agreed project management standards and processes and will share best practices to support the continuous improvement of design and development speed, efficiency, and quality. The project manager, Assistant Director, will be able to manage autonomously, with limited need for supervision.
   

  

 This role will provide the opportunity to work in a dynamic, fast paced environment supporting multiple projects at a time.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Deliver learning design and development projects (including large scale, highly complex projects) on time, to budget and quality standards
* Develop a detailed project plan for each project, based on a standard template, identifying deliverable due dates and review cycles
* Establish and maintain relationships with a variety of stakeholders including subject matter resources, other learning stakeholders, and third\-party learning vendors
* Ensure adherence to operations and compliance processes including procurement, finance, and Risk Management
* Coordinate and monitor the work of vendor project managers, designers, and developers where applicable
* Identify and assess risks and consult with leadership or stakeholders on options in a timely manner
* Facilitate and lead regular project and team meetings
* Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation
* Leverage and share best practices of project management with other team members
* Mentor and provide guidance to junior project managers on the team
* Make recommendations to leadership regarding competing priorities and resource management issues
* Initiate and ensure the effective and timely publication of learning content by content administration
* Measure project performance using appropriate systems, tools, and techniques


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**To qualify for the role you must have:**
* Minimum of 8\-10 years of experience in managing learning design and development projects, preferably at a global level and/or to a dispersed client base
* Demonstrable experience involving project management skills including management of vendors
* Demonstrable experience in concurrently managing multiple, large\-scale, and highly complex learning and development projects involving all delivery channels/types
* Demonstrable experience using project management software, including Microsoft Excel
* Demonstrable experience of having built and maintained strong relationships with business customers/clients, including at the senior or c\-suite level
* Demonstrable experience of thinking and acting strategically and commercially in pursuit of the wider EY business objectives
* Demonstratable experience of mentoring and providing guidance to junior team members


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Strong knowledge of \- and commitment to optimize \- learning end\-to\-end processes and standards
* Knowledge of learning science and evidence\-based design standards and practices to ensure that EY’s learning content is of the highest quality and has the desired business impact
* A bachelor’s degree and ideally higher professional or master’s qualification in a related discipline


**What We Look For**
* An experienced project manager who strives to improve process and exceed leadership’s needs
* A professional who can quickly problem solve and can offer perspective on solutions
* A professional who demonstrates resilience and is energized by working in a global environment, proactively seeking different opinions, valuing, and leveraging diverse perspectives


**What We Offer**
 As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, global team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial, and social well\-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Demonstrated expert data management skills and advanced knowledge of the data management process (e.g., therapeutic area, extensive knowledge in DM processes, SAE reconciliation, external data vendor reconciliation, management of local laboratory data, and/or new technology). Previous experience and proven competence in handling complex customer negotiations and bid defense meetings independently. Knowledge of Medical Terminology, Pharmacology, Anatomy, and/or Physiology.  We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.

 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
* Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
* Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
* Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
* Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
* Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.


**Opportunity Role: SAP BODS Manager (7\+ Years)**
 We are looking for an SAP BODS Manager with deep expertise in end to end SAP data migration to lead ECC to S/4HANA and cloud migration programs. The role requires a strong blend of technical leadership, delivery ownership, and stakeholder management, working across large scale global transformation initiatives.
   

  

**Role \& Client Responsibilities**
* Lead end to end SAP data migration workstreams using SAP BODS
* Own solution design for complex migration scenarios (ECC → S/4HANA, cloud, carve outs)
* Act as the primary technical point of contact for customers on data migration
* Drive migration strategy, approach, sequencing, and cutover planning
* Collaborate with functional leads, architects, and cross track teams
* Interface with onsite leads, program managers, and global delivery teams


**Review and approve:**
* Migration design documents
* BODS architecture and job designs
* Data validation and reconciliation strategies
* Proactively identify migration risks and define mitigation plans
* Support presales activities including:
* Solutioning
* Effort estimation
* Technical inputs for proposals


**People \& Delivery Responsibilities**
* Manage and mentor BODS developers (junior to senior levels)
* Assign and monitor work, ensuring quality and adherence to timelines
* Establish and enforce development standards and best practices
* Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and technical walkthroughs
* Build a strong quality driven and ownership focused delivery culture
* Participate in hiring, onboarding, and performance evaluations
* Drive internal capability building, accelerators, and reusable assets


**Technical Skills \& Experience**
* 7\+ years of experience in SAP data migration with strong BODS focus
* Proven track record of leading multiple end to end migration cycles


**Expert level knowledge of:**
* SAP BODS architecture, design, and performance optimization
* Jobs, dataflows, workflows, transformations, and error handling


**Strong hands on experience with:**
* ECC to S/4HANA data migration
* SAP source and target systems


**Hands on exposure to:**
* S/4HANA Data Migration Cockpit (LTMC / Fiori Migration Object Modeler)
* IDOC / BAPI based integrations using BODS
* Advanced SQL skills for complex data analysis and issue resolution
* Functional understanding of SAP process areas like Finance, Sales and Distribution, Material Management etc


**Experience in:**
* BODS installation, configuration, scheduling, and Management Console
* Migration mock cycles, dress rehearsals, and cutover execution


**Ability to produce:**
* Migration strategies
* Technical architectures
* Detailed effort estimates and plans
* Good understanding of data warehousing concepts and ETL best practices

title: Incident & Change Management Coordinator
description:
Dodge Construction Network (Dodge) is looking for a detail\-oriented, process\-driven professional to build out and mature our Incident Management and Change Management functions. These functions currently exist but lack formal structure\-this role will own the transformation from ad hoc handling to a disciplined, auditable, well\-governed practice. You'll design and implement the processes, approval workflows, and reporting that give engineering, IT, and leadership confidence that incidents are resolved consistently and changes are reviewed, approved, and tracked before they hit production. This is a hands\-on process\-and\-tooling role, not just a policy\-writing one. You'll be expected to build the actual workflows, forms, and automations inside our Atlassian ecosystem (Jira, Confluence, and related apps) that make the new processes stick.
   

  

 This is a full\-time position and reports directly to the VP, IT Infrastructure and Operations.
   

  

***Preferred Location***
 Qualified candidates should be based in or near Kochi and able to work from our Kochi office as part of a hybrid schedule.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
**Incident Management**
* Formalize incident management processes: severity classification, escalation paths, communication protocols, and resolution SLAs
* Own the incident lifecycle in Jira Service Management (or Jira), from detection/logging through resolution and closure
* Drive post\-incident reviews (blameless retrospectives / RCAs), ensure action items are tracked and closed, and report on recurring themes
* Build dashboards and recurring reports on incident volume, MTTR, severity trends, and SLA compliance for leadership visibility


**Change Management**
* Design and implement a formal Change Management process, including change categorization (standard/normal/emergency), risk assessment, and CAB (Change Advisory Board) review cadence
* Build structured Jira workflows and forms to capture change requests, required approvals, rollback plans, and post\-implementation review
* Partner with engineering, infrastructure, and application teams (AWS, M365, Atlassian, and internal platforms) to ensure changes are properly vetted before deployment
* Track change success/failure rates and use data to continuously refine the process


**Tooling, Automation \& Governance**
* Configure and maintain Jira workflows, schemes, automation rules, and Jira Service Management request forms to support both processes end\-to\-end
* Use Atlassian automation (Jira Automation, Confluence integrations, forms) to reduce manual steps\-auto\-routing, approval reminders, SLA breach alerts, ticket linking, etc.
* Maintain Confluence documentation: runbooks, process guides, RACI charts, and CAB meeting notes
* Establish approval workflows and audit trails that satisfy internal governance and any relevant compliance requirements
* Identify opportunities to integrate Incident/Change data with other systems (e.g., monitoring/alerting tools, CMDB\-type asset tracking) as the practice matures


**Cross\-Functional Coordination**
* Act as the process owner and point of contact across engineering, infrastructure, and vendor/contractor teams for all things incident and change related
* Facilitate CAB meetings and post\-incident reviews, keeping them efficient and action\-oriented
* Train and onboard teams on new processes, driving adoption without becoming a bottleneck


***Education Requirement***
 Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent education and work experience.
   

  

**Required Experience, Knowledge And Skills**
* 3\+ years of experience in Incident Management, Change Management, IT Service Management (ITSM), or a Project/Program Management role with process\-ownership responsibility
* Hands\-on experience administering Atlassian products\-Jira and/or Jira Service Management required; Confluence experience strongly preferred
* Demonstrated experience building Jira workflows, automation rules, and forms (Jira Service Management request forms or similar) \- this is not just "used Jira," but "configured Jira."
* Strong understanding of ITIL\-aligned incident and change management concepts (formal ITIL certification is a plus, not required)
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to build structure from ambiguity\-you'll be creating a lot of this from scratch
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable facilitating meetings with technical and non\-technical stakeholders, including leadership
* Data\-oriented mindset\-comfortable building reports/dashboards to show process health and drive continuous improvement
* Experience working in a technical environment (cloud infrastructure, SaaS, or software engineering organization) is a strong plus, even if you're not an engineer yourself


**Preferred Experience, Knowledge And Skills**
* ITIL v3/v4 Foundation certification
* Experience with Jira Service Management's Change and Incident\-specific templates/features
* Familiarity with AWS or Microsoft 365 environments (you won't need to administer them but understanding what a "change" looks like in these environments helps)
* Experience supporting SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar compliance frameworks where change/incident records are auditable evidence


**About Dodge Construction Network**
 Dodge Construction Network exists to deliver the comprehensive data and connections the construction industry needs to build thriving communities. Our legacy is deeply rooted in empowering our customers with transformative insights, igniting their journey towards unparalleled business expansion and success. We serve decision\-makers who seek reliable growth and who value relationships built on trust and quality. By combining our proprietary data with cutting\-edge software, we deliver to our customers the essential intelligence needed to excel within their respective landscapes. We propel the construction industry forward by transforming data into tangible guidance, driving unparalleled advancement.
